codebook_texts.C_global: Weathered pink wall with white markings and green vines casting shadows overhead.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter forest scene under overcast sky, captured in infrared for surreal visual effect.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman in red jacket gazes upward at large red balloon floating in sunlit forest.

codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Men dressed casually, some holding phones, standing or walking along brick-paved alley.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows multi-story buildings with windows and balconies lining the alley.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People are clustered together, some conversing, others walking, creating social interaction scene.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones, rough brick pavement, textured walls, and varied clothing fabrics visible.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban alleyway with buildings on both sides, under natural daylight conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime city skyline reflects vibrant lights across calm water under dark sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall buildings with illuminated windows and domed structure dominate the urban horizon.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Bright streetlights line waterfront, casting warm reflections on the still water surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: City lights mirror in water, creating symmetrical glow patterns along the shoreline.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange and white lights contrast with deep blue night sky and dark water texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban waterfront at night with clear sky, calm water, and artificial lighting illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman stands outdoors reaching toward sky as flock of seagulls flies around her.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman wears white tank top, has dark hair, and raises one arm upward toward birds.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Multiple seagulls in mid-flight, some near woman, others scattered across blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Woman appears to interact with birds, possibly feeding or encouraging them to fly.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Sky transitions from soft blue to warm yellow near horizon, with wispy white clouds.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal or open field scene during late afternoon or early evening.

codebook_texts.C_global: A vintage-style street lamp stands still as a red car blurs past on asphalt road.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Ornate metal lamp with glass enclosure mounted atop black pole.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred red vehicle streaking horizontally across gray pavement surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lamp remains stationary while car moves rapidly, creating motion blur effect.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth gray asphalt, metallic sheen on lamp, translucent glass panel, dark pole finish.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene under daylight with visible yellow lane marking.

codebook_texts.C_global: A female singer performs passionately on stage under colorful stage lights.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman with dark hair and a pink flower in her hair sings into a microphone.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A blurred male musician in the background plays guitar with a strap over his shoulder.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The singer holds the mic close to her mouth while standing center stage, illuminated by spotlights.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange and cool blue stage lights contrast with the dark background and singer's black top.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor live music venue with dim ambient lighting and visible stage equipment overhead.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of a majestic owl with intense gaze, set against blurred urban background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Owl features prominent ear tufts, sharp orange eyes, and mottled white-brown feathers.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows out-of-focus vertical structures, possibly metal poles or railings.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Owl is facing forward, head slightly tilted, suggesting alert observation or focus.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Feathers display intricate speckled patterns of white, brown, and gray with soft, fluffy texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with diffused natural lighting and shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Handcrafted fabric book rests on green patterned table near beige sofa.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Embroidered fabric book with stitched house, tree, and 'home' text.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red button-adorned spine and white lace trim decorate the book's edge.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Book sits stationary on table, positioned in front of a couch.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Green floral tablecloth, beige sofa, and textured fabric book cover.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor living room setting with soft lighting and cozy furniture.

codebook_texts.C_global: A bright pink toy fish rests on weathered turquoise surface near ocean waves.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Small plastic fish with big white eyes and open mouth lies on textured surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred rocky outcrop and foamy sea waves appear in background behind toy.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Toy is positioned in foreground, facing viewer, with ocean behind it.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant pink plastic contrasts with weathered teal surface and blue ocean.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal scene under bright daylight with partly cloudy sky.

codebook_texts.C_global: A single hazelnut and its cracked shell rest on a dark wooden surface under warm lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A whole hazelnut with smooth, rounded surface and natural brown tones sits upright.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: An empty, split hazelnut shell lies beside the whole nut, showing inner ridges and texture.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The whole nut and broken shell are placed side by side, suggesting recent cracking or consumption.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich brown hues dominate, with glossy nut surface and matte, grainy wood texture contrasting softly.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor still-life scene with shallow depth of field, warm ambient lighting, and wooden tabletop background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Grid-framed view of lush cacti and succulents under glass greenhouse roof.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall, segmented cacti with spines stand prominently in segmented glass panes.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Diverse succulents and desert plants arranged in gravel beds beneath glass ceiling.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Plants are arranged in rows, viewed through a grid of square glass panes.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm sunlight highlights green, brown, and gray textures of plants and glass.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Bright, sunlit indoor greenhouse with arched glass roof and stone pathways.

codebook_texts.C_global: Urban street scene with towering skyscrapers, pedestrians, and vehicles under soft golden hour lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall glass and steel skyscrapers with reflective windows dominate the cityscape's verticality.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red traffic lights and parked cars line the street, adding urban infrastructure detail.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Pedestrians walk along sidewalks while vehicles move along the street below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden tones from sunset contrast with cool glass reflections and dark asphalt textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor city street during late afternoon with clear skies and tall buildings creating a canyon effect.

codebook_texts.C_global: Foggy monochrome seascape with wooden pilings receding into misty distance.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Dark vertical pilings emerge from water, diminishing in size toward horizon.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Surface ripples gently reflect muted tones, enhancing atmospheric depth.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Pilings align linearly, creating vanishing point illusion in foggy environment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic grayscale tones with smooth water texture and grainy fog.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Overcast coastal scene under dense fog, suggesting early morning or late evening.

codebook_texts.C_global: Winding road stretches through mountainous terrain under dramatic cloudy skies.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Yellow double lines run down center of asphalt road, fading into distance.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense evergreen trees line both sides of road near rocky mountain slopes.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Road recedes into horizon, creating perspective with mountains framing scene.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow paint contrasts with dark asphalt and green foliage under bright sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountain landscape with partly cloudy weather and natural daylight illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunset bathes lush tropical landscape in golden hues, silhouetting distant hills and dense foliage.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A small wooden structure nestled among banana plants and thick greenery on a hillside.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense canopy of trees and shrubs with banana leaves framing the foreground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The sun sets behind distant hills, casting long shadows across the vegetation and terrain.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden tones blend with deep greens and earthy browns in textured foliage and sky gradients.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor tropical valley at golden hour, with misty mountains and calm atmospheric lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of vintage Polaroid camera with rainbow stripe and red shutter button.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Circular lens with black interior, surrounded by white plastic casing.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red circular button positioned left of lens, labeled 'OneStep' above it.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Camera angled slightly upward, showing top portion with lens and button alignment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth white plastic surface with vibrant rainbow stripe and matte red button.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor studio lighting casting soft shadows on camera's textured surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: A meerkat stands upright on sandy ground, alert and gazing directly at the camera.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The meerkat has a fluffy gray coat, rounded ears, and dark eyes, standing on hind legs.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The background consists of scattered pebbles and dry earth, creating a naturalistic setting.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The meerkat is positioned centrally, facing forward, with its front paws held near its chest.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The fur displays a mix of light brown and gray tones with a soft, slightly matted texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor desert-like environment under bright sunlight, casting sharp shadows on the ground.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant graffiti mural adorns a beige wall under clear blue sky, showcasing bold artistic expression.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Stylized graffiti artwork with swirling patterns and abstract forms dominates the wall surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A small black security light fixture is mounted on the wall above the mural's upper edge.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The mural's dynamic elements appear to flow across the wall, creating a sense of movement and depth.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich palette of fiery oranges, electric blues, and vivid purples with glossy, textured spray-painted surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene with bright daylight, clear sky, and concrete ground beneath the mural wall.

codebook_texts.C_global: A geisha in traditional attire stands indoors, holding a fan, with wooden architecture behind her.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Geisha with white face paint, red lips, and ornate hairpiece, wearing a purple kimono with white collar.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wooden cabinet with carved panels and vertical slats, partially visible behind the geisha.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Geisha holds a folding fan in front of her, positioned slightly to the side, facing right.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich purple fabric, white lace collar, red accents, and glossy white makeup on the face.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor traditional Japanese setting with warm ambient lighting and wooden interior decor.

codebook_texts.C_global: A wooden boat floats peacefully on calm blue water under soft ambient light.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A long, narrow wooden boat with a pointed bow and visible planks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A single red-painted oar rests horizontally inside the boat’s interior.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The boat is stationary, viewed from directly above, anchored near the water’s edge.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep teal water contrasts with dark brown weathered wood and a red oar handle.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor aquatic scene with still water, clear lighting, and no visible weather disturbances.

codebook_texts.C_global: Colorful European buildings line a narrow street under overcast skies.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Multi-story residential buildings with shuttered windows and tiled roofs.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A small balcony with metal railing attached to the yellow building.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Buildings stand side by side, sharing walls and varying in height and color.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Worn ochre, deep red, and brick textures contrast with dark green shutters.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban street scene in a historic town, cloudy weather, daytime lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Hand holds vibrant sunflower photo against blurred urban street backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Hand grips small rectangular photo with vivid yellow sunflowers and blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark sedan parked on street beside beige building with ornate window frames.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person presents photo in foreground while car and building remain out of focus behind.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich yellow petals contrast with deep blue sky, while asphalt and beige wall show muted tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene under dim lighting with shallow depth of field emphasizing the photo.

codebook_texts.C_global: A cyclist rides past a bus stop as a photographer captures the moment from a car's side mirror.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A man in a plaid shirt and cap pedals a blue bicycle with yellow handlebars.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A green bus shelter with posters and a bench sits beside a red curb and trash can.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The cyclist moves forward while a photographer films from inside a vehicle.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Blue bicycle frame, plaid shirt pattern, red painted curb, and green shelter panels.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban street scene under daylight with commercial buildings and parked cars in background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vintage camper trailer rests in open field during twilight with soft pastel sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Retro-style travel trailer with corrugated metal siding and white door stands alone.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Two propane tanks attached to rear, surrounded by tall grass and distant trees.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Trailer parked stationary on grass, positioned near field edge with no visible occupants.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Weathered silver metal, faded red panel, and white door contrast with green grass and pink sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural landscape at dusk with soft lighting, clear horizon, and scattered trees.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman reaches up to clean ceiling corner in warmly lit home with hardwood floors.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person with shoulder-length hair wears black top and dark jeans while suspended mid-air.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White ceiling meets wall trim, with open doorway revealing adjacent room and bookshelf.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person stretches upward, one leg kicked back, standing on tiptoe to reach high spot.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth white ceiling, dark denim texture, light wood flooring, and cream-colored walls.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor residential setting with natural light from window, hardwood floors, and white trim.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant graffiti art covers a weathered wall, blending bold colors and abstract shapes in an urban alleyway.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A large, stylized graffiti piece with yellow, red, and black tones dominates the wall’s center.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A faded green and white banner with 'FRIEND' text appears above the main mural.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Graffiti tags and abstract forms are layered across the wall, creating a chaotic yet intentional composition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich yellows, deep reds, and stark blacks contrast with rough concrete and peeling paint textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene under natural daylight, featuring a gritty alley with a dirt ground and brick wall.

codebook_texts.C_global: Various Dash Ika Com promotional cards arranged on wooden surface with vibrant designs.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Promotional cards featuring Dash Ika Com logo and 'Rulez!' slogan in multiple artistic styles.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black ninja silhouette and colorful bunny graphic appear on some card designs.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cards are laid out in three rows on a wooden table, showcasing diverse visual themes.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Bright colors like yellow, blue, red, and black with striped, solid, and patterned textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with natural lighting on a light brown wooden tabletop surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Hand painted with peace symbol and message against dark background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Open palm displaying colorful peace sign and handwritten text.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark fabric backdrop contrasting with the brightly painted hand.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Hand positioned palm-up, symbolizing peace message displayed openly.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue and pink hues with chalk-like texture on skin surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with controlled lighting highlighting the hand against dark fabric.

codebook_texts.C_global: A serene mountain river flows past a large boulder, surrounded by lush green trees and rocky cliffs.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A massive, moss-covered boulder stands partially submerged in clear turquoise water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall slender trees with fresh green leaves line the riverbank, casting reflections on the water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The boulder is positioned near the river's edge, with its reflection mirrored in the calm water surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant turquoise water contrasts with the gray, mossy boulder and lush green foliage surrounding it.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountain valley scene under bright daylight, with clear skies and natural vegetation.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman stands in golden wheat field, sunlight casting warm glow over her relaxed pose.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Young woman with dark hair, wearing black tank top, gently touching wheat stalks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red bracelet on her wrist and ear adorned with small earring.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She leans slightly forward, hand resting on wheat, other hand near ear, eyes closed.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Golden wheat stalks contrast with her black top, sunlit skin tones and textured grass.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural setting under bright sunlight, with blurred greenery in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Young woman in maid outfit sits on wooden floor near window with fluffy white rug behind her.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Girl with pigtails and headband wears plaid blouse, black skirt, and lace-trimmed apron.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White fluffy rug and window with bare tree branches visible outside provide background context.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She sits cross-legged, hand near face, looking directly at camera with thoughtful expression.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Plaid patterned fabric, soft white lace, smooth black velvet, and glossy black shoes with texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor scene with natural daylight streaming through window, wooden flooring, and bright ambiance.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman in traditional attire sits calmly on a bench near a glass barrier in an urban setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman wearing a white hijab and beige abaya sits upright on a bench.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Metal railings and glass panels form a barrier behind the bench with scattered litter below.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The woman is seated alone, facing forward, with her hands resting on her lap.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth beige fabric, crisp white hijab, and reflective glass surfaces with metallic railings.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban environment under bright daylight with modern architectural elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunset paints sky and water in warm hues, silhouetting trees and distant houses near calm pond.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Sun dips below horizon, casting golden glow across clouds and reflecting on still water surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall utility pole stands on right, its silhouette mirrored in pond against twilight backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Sunlight radiates through clouds, illuminating sky while trees and houses remain dark silhouettes.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange and yellow tones blend into soft blue, with smooth reflective water and dark silhouettes.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural landscape at dusk, featuring calm pond, scattered trees, and clear atmospheric conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: A young person in a light blue shirt has a small lizard climbing on their neck outdoors.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A small lizard with a long tail and textured skin is clinging to a person's neck.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark metal fence and green leafy plants are visible in the background behind the person.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The lizard is positioned vertically on the person's neck, near their ear and collar.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Light blue fabric of the shirt contrasts with the green foliage and the lizard's brownish scales.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor setting with natural daylight, trees, and a metal fence in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Narrow alleyway between weathered buildings under bright blue sky with shadows cast.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall, aged stone buildings with wooden shutters and balconies line the alley.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wooden chair and rusted metal poles stand in the alley's center.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Buildings flank the alley, creating a confined passage with sunlight filtering through.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Weathered gray stone walls, faded blue shutters, and bright sunlit patches contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban alley with Mediterranean-style architecture under clear daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Ancient stone mausoleum with arched roof and multiple tomb doors nestled in overgrown greenery.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Curved stone structure with triangular pediments and weathered tomb doors aligned in a row.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense green foliage and trees rise behind the mausoleum, partially obscuring the sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Tomb doors stand closed in a linear arrangement, with a dirt path winding between them.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Weathered gray stone with mossy patches, vibrant green grass, and rough textured surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor cemetery scene under natural daylight with overcast sky and lush vegetation.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two people stroll along a wide riverbank under clear blue skies with lush green trees lining the shore.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two individuals stand near the water's edge, one in red shirt and one in light-colored clothing.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A fallen log stretches across shallow water, surrounded by rocks and patches of sand.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People are walking along the riverbank, with trees and water forming a natural backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blue water contrasts with sandy banks, green foliage, and bright sunlight casting shadows.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor river landscape on a sunny day with clear skies and dense forested banks.

codebook_texts.C_global: Hand adjusts knobs on dimly lit audio mixer in atmospheric, warm-toned studio setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Hand with dark sleeve presses a knob on a textured, metallic audio mixing console.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred background with glowing yellow lights and out-of-focus control panel elements.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Finger manipulates a control knob while other knobs remain stationary in close-up view.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm amber lighting highlights metallic surfaces and soft fabric texture of sleeve.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor music production environment with low-key, moody lighting and shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white photograph captures serene mountain lake surrounded by dense evergreen trees.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Central rocky island juts from calm water, mirrored perfectly in its still surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Foreground pine trees frame the view, their dark silhouettes contrasting with reflective water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Trees line the shoreline, while distant forested hills encircle the tranquil lake scene.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast monochrome tones emphasize rough bark, smooth water ripples, and rocky textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountain lake environment under overcast lighting, creating soft shadows and deep blacks.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime street view of Tokyo Diner, illuminated sign, pedestrians passing by.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large white sign with bold black letters spelling 'TOKYO DINER' above entrance.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wooden-framed glass windows display interior menu and posters inside.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People walk past diner entrance, some standing near doorway in dim light.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark shadows contrast with bright sign, warm interior glow, textured pavement.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban nighttime street scene with artificial lighting and sidewalk pedestrians.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted woman and child hold hands against bright vertical light panels in dimly lit room.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall adult figure in flowing dress leans forward to grasp small child's hand.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vertical illuminated panels with evenly spaced circular lights form backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Adult and child stand facing each other, connected by hand in intimate gesture.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High contrast black silhouettes against glowing white background with smooth floor.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with controlled lighting, likely gallery or performance space.

codebook_texts.C_global: Misty morning lake reflects trees and a wooden structure, creating serene, mirrored surroundings.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A weathered wooden structure stands upright in calm water, partially obscured by fog.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense forested hills fade into misty background, mirrored perfectly on the water’s surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Structure is centered in frame, surrounded by still water and fog, with birds scattered in distance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft purples, muted greens, and grayish whites dominate, with smooth water and rough wooden textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor lakeside scene at dawn, enveloped in fog, with calm water and forested surroundings.

codebook_texts.C_global: A dynamic splash of white liquid captured mid-air against a stark black background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A vibrant blue bowl holding creamy white liquid with a stream pouring into it.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A single droplet suspended in air above the swirling milk surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Liquid is actively falling into the bowl, creating a splash and ripples.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blue glossy surface contrasts with smooth white liquid and black void.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: High-contrast studio shot with controlled lighting and pure black backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Ancient stone church stands alone in vast green field under dramatic cloudy sky at sunset.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Weathered stone church with bell tower and sloped roof, showing rustic architectural style.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall grasses and wild plants in foreground frame the church, adding natural texture.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Church positioned centrally in open field, with horizon line separating land and sky.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rough textured stone walls, vibrant green grass, and soft golden light against dark clouds.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural landscape at dusk with moody sky, suggesting peaceful yet dramatic atmosphere.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunset bathes a solitary stone house atop a rolling green hill under vast sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Small rustic house with red-tiled roof and stone walls stands alone on hilltop.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Cluster of dark trees and low stone wall appear near house on right side.

codebook_texts.C_global: A dramatic, sepia-toned image of a spiked plant against rugged mountainous terrain under a cloudy sky.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunrise filters through silhouetted trees over misty grassy field at dawn.

codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person wearing a silver helmet and red shirt leans forward while riding a blue bicycle.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows motion-blurred buildings and greenery along the sidewalk.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Rider is actively pedaling and balancing on the bike mid-motion with wheels off the ground.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red shirt, blue bike frame, and striped shorts contrast with the blurred beige and green background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with bright daylight, concrete pavement, and motion blur indicating high speed.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman sits nude on a bed, gazing directly at the camera in a moody black-and-white portrait.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman with long dark hair, sitting curled with arms crossed over her knees.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A rumpled white sheet beneath her, contrasting with the dark background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She maintains direct eye contact, seated in a contemplative, introspective pose.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones with soft gradients, smooth skin texture, and stark shadows.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor studio setting with dramatic lighting, dark backdrop, and intimate composition.

codebook_texts.C_global: Handwritten message declares revolution as only solution on plain white surface.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Black ink handwriting spells out bold political statement across center of image.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Smooth, unmarked white background provides stark contrast to dark text.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Text is arranged in stacked lines with emphasis on 'ONLY' underlined for impact.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Uniform matte white surface with subtle shadows and faint grain texture visible.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Minimalist indoor setting with even lighting and no discernible environmental context.

codebook_texts.C_global: Doll classroom scene with children seated at desks, educational posters, and colorful props.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Blond-haired doll sitting on wooden chair, wearing blue shoes and gray sweater.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red suitcase with metal clasps and black hat resting on chair beside it.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dolls arranged as students in classroom, some facing front, others turned sideways.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Bright red suitcase, striped wallpaper, glossy white floor, and textured blackboard.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor classroom setting with artificial lighting, educational decor, and toy furniture.

codebook_texts.C_global: A snowy urban scene features a monkey poster and pedestrians walking past.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A monkey holding a snowball appears on a large outdoor poster.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A woman in a brown fur coat walks past the poster on the sidewalk.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The poster is mounted on a stand, with people moving in the background.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The fur coat has a rich brown texture, while snowflakes appear white and soft.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter city street with pavement, buildings, and falling snow.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person in green shirt and white pants stands beside vintage green car with chrome trim.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person wearing bright green top, white pants, and studded lime belt near car door.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark green classic car with 'Dart Swinger' emblem and reflective window.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person positioned beside car, likely preparing to enter or exit, with reflection visible.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green fabric, crisp white pants, metallic chrome accents, and glossy car paint.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with natural daylight, pavement ground, and vehicle parked on street.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant rainbow arcs across tropical sky, framed by palm trees and distant ocean horizon.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall slender palm trees with feathery fronds stand prominently against the sky.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark storm clouds contrast with bright blue sky, creating dramatic weather backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Rainbow emerges from cloud cover, positioned above palm trees and coastal landscape.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vivid rainbow hues blend with deep blue sky, green palm fronds, and gray storm clouds.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor tropical coastal scene under partly cloudy weather with visible ocean in distance.

codebook_texts.C_global: Serene canal scene with historic buildings, moored boats, and leafless trees under clear sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large stone building with gabled roof, dormer windows, and attached glass conservatory.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Willow tree with yellowing leaves, narrow canal path, and moored narrowboat along water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Boats rest beside canal bank, buildings line waterway, and path runs parallel to water.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm stone tones, reflective water surface, green grass, and muted sky with soft lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor canal-side setting in early spring, clear weather, calm water, and tranquil atmosphere.

codebook_texts.C_global: Burnt newspaper rests on dark grill grates, showing charred edges and faded text.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Charred newspaper fragment with visible text, partially melted and curled at edges.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rusted metal grill grates beneath the newspaper, showing wear and soot.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Newspaper lies discarded on grill, suggesting recent burning or disposal.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Blackened, rough textures contrast with faded white paper and smoky gray ash.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor cooking area at night, dimly lit, with dark background and metallic surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant cosmic explosion radiates outward, filled with glowing particles against dark void.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Central radiant burst emits intense orange light, surrounded by cascading specks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blue and yellow specks scatter across background, contrasting with dominant red glow.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Particles appear to explode radially from center, creating dynamic motion illusion.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange and red hues dominate, contrasted by cool blue and yellow specks against black.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Abstract digital space scene, illuminated by artificial particle effects in darkness.

codebook_texts.C_global: A clear glass filled with frothy white liquid sits on a metallic surface under dim lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall cylindrical glass holds a bubbly, opaque white liquid with condensation droplets on its sides.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Metallic tabletop with brushed texture and faint scratches reflects ambient light subtly.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Glass rests centrally on the table, liquid level near the rim, bubbles rising gently.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White frothy liquid contrasts with dark background; glass is transparent with wet condensation.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with low-key lighting, dark backdrop, and reflective metallic surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Colorful candies, decorative flowers, and a framed mirror arranged on a soft white blanket.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A framed mirror with a decorative border made of rolled-up paper and red flowers.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A bag of Sour Patch Kids candies with bright pink packaging and assorted gummy candies.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Items are scattered around the mirror, suggesting a display or gift arrangement.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft white blanket, vibrant red and pink candies, textured fabric flowers, and glossy wrappers.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with warm lighting, featuring a cozy, decorative arrangement on a textured surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white portrait of a smiling woman near a storefront with neon sign.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman with shoulder-length hair and bangs, wearing striped top and patterned scarf.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Neon sign reading 'Re' visible in background, glass storefront reflection.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Subject gazes slightly off-camera, positioned close to window with reflective surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones, soft skin texture, striped fabric pattern, and glossy glass surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban street scene at night, illuminated by artificial lighting and storefront reflections.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dark storm clouds loom over a winding road through grassy hillsides under dramatic lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A curving asphalt road stretches forward with white lane markings under an overcast sky.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall grasses and scattered trees line the roadside, with distant rolling hills in the background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The road curves gently to the right, viewed from a vehicle's perspective with guardrails on the left.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blues and grays dominate the sky, contrasted with green vegetation and gray pavement textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural highway scene under threatening storm clouds with low-angle dramatic lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of a dog's lower body and paws on carpeted floor near furniture.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Dog with white and brown fur, spotted legs, and visible collar with tag.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blue collar with bone-shaped tag and wooden furniture in background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dog standing still, paws planted on carpet, viewed from low angle near floor.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft beige carpet, fluffy white fur with brown spots, wooden furniture texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with warm lighting, carpeted floor, and furniture visible in background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Blurred dancers in vibrant attire move energetically under warm stage lights.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman in a shiny red dress dances with her back to the camera, wearing high heels.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Another dancer in a floral dress moves beside her, partially obscured by motion blur.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dancers are closely positioned, suggesting a social dance or club setting with dynamic movement.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Shiny metallic red fabric contrasts with warm yellow lighting and blurred colorful patterns.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor nightclub or dance floor with artificial lighting, dark background, and motion blur effects.

codebook_texts.C_global: Motorcyclists camp in a valley surrounded by towering green mountains under a bright blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A blue motorcycle with a rider wearing a helmet and gear parked near a tent.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A yellow dome tent and a green tent clustered together in the foreground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People are gathered around motorcycles and tents, suggesting a group camping event.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow, green, and blue tents contrast with the grassy terrain and rocky mountain textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountain camping scene with clear weather, daylight, and rugged natural landscape.

codebook_texts.C_global: Protesters surround a burning American flag on a city sidewalk during a demonstration.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A large American flag engulfed in flames, held by unseen hands above the ground.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A black camera lens in the foreground, capturing the scene from a low angle.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People stand in a circle around the burning flag, some holding cameras to record the event.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange flames contrast with the flag's red, white, and blue, and gray pavement.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene with overcast lighting and smoke rising into the air.

codebook_texts.C_global: City skyline looms over busy highway under dramatic cloudy evening sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Multiple lanes of highway filled with moving vehicles under streetlights.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall skyscrapers and distant hills frame the urban landscape in background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cars travel in both directions along curving elevated roadway with traffic flow.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark blue-gray clouds, asphalt texture, and metallic streetlight fixtures dominate scene.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban highway scene at dusk with overcast weather and artificial lighting active.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow blankets a rustic barn with American flag painted on its roof, beside a tall silo under overcast skies.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Weathered wooden barn with sloped roof, showing signs of age and snow accumulation.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall cylindrical silo stands adjacent to the barn, both structures surrounded by bare trees and snow.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Barn and silo are positioned side by side, with flag painted on roof, suggesting rural farmstead layout.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Grayish-brown wood, white snow, faded red and blue flag, and muted gray sky create a textured, wintry palette.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Winter rural farm scene with overcast lighting, snow-covered ground, and leafless trees in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of two human feet resting together, softly lit in a calm indoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Feet with natural skin tone, visible toes, and slight hair on the soles.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred background with warm beige tones and soft lighting on the floor.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Feet positioned side by side, slightly overlapping, captured from a top-down angle.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, pale skin with subtle natural texture and soft, even lighting highlights.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor environment with neutral background, likely a living room or bedroom setting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Bright green LED lights arranged in a dense grid glow vividly against a dark background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Rows of illuminated green LEDs with rounded domes and metallic leads mounted on a circuit board.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black wires and a perforated circuit board base supporting the LED array in the foreground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: LEDs are uniformly lit and organized in a rectangular formation, suggesting a display or testing setup.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green glow with smooth, glossy dome surfaces and dark, matte metallic leads.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Dark indoor setting with focused lighting highlighting the glowing LEDs against a black backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man asks for handshake, but is denied in dimly lit hallway with text overlay.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Bearded man in gray t-shirt with black strap across chest, looking sideways.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Person in red shirt with glasses and name tag standing in background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Handshake gesture is rejected, with one hand extended and other declining.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm lighting casts soft shadows, with wood paneling and muted earth tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor hallway with wooden walls, ceiling light, and people in casual attire.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman with flowing hair gazes directly at the camera against a plain white background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Her face is centered, showing green eyes and a neutral expression with wind-blown dark hair.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A delicate silver necklace is visible around her neck, partially obscured by her hair.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Her hair appears to be moving dynamically, suggesting motion or wind effect in the shot.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth skin tones contrast with dark brown hair and subtle metallic sheen of the necklace.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio setting with bright, even lighting and a clean white backdrop for portrait photography.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up portrait of a young woman with red hair, resting her chin on her hand.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Young woman with fair skin, soft facial features, and a gentle smile.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Delicate black ink tattoo on her neck, featuring swirling patterns and dots.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She gazes slightly upward, hand supporting her chin in a contemplative pose.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm lighting highlights her skin, with soft red hair and subtle matte texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with shallow depth of field, dark background emphasizing subject.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sailboat glides across water as sun sets behind Statue of Liberty silhouette.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Sailboat with white sails and crew members visible on deck.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Statue of Liberty stands tall on pedestal, holding torch aloft against sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Boat sails near statue, reflecting golden light on rippling water surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange and pink hues glow across sky and water, contrasting dark silhouettes.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Sunset over harbor with distant city skyline, calm water, and clear atmospheric lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of colorful icing swirls on a cake, showing vibrant decorations and creamy frosting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Blue and orange icing piped in wavy, intertwined patterns across the cake surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Creamy white frosting base beneath the colorful icing swirls, forming a textured background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Icing strands cross and loop over each other, creating a decorative, layered design.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue and orange icing contrast with smooth, creamy white frosting texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor, well-lit setting with soft lighting highlighting the cake's decorative details.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person lounges on grass with legs extended, wearing dark pants and white socks.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person lying on grass, legs stretched out, wearing dark jeans and white socks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blue plaid blanket partially visible under person's legs on grass.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person appears relaxed, lying flat on grass with feet pointing away from camera.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Green grass with patches of brown soil, dark denim texture, and white sock with pink stripe.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor grassy area under natural daylight, suggesting a casual, sunny day setting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman poses with hands under chin, lips puckered, in a black-and-white portrait.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman with styled hair, wearing earrings and lingerie, gazes directly at camera.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black tie hangs vertically in background, contrasting with light wall behind subject.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Subject rests elbows on surface, hands supporting chin, creating intimate portrait composition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones emphasize smooth skin, soft hair texture, and subtle fabric patterns.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor studio setting with bright, even lighting and plain background for focused portrait.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant green moss blankets a weathered tree stump in a forest, with soft natural lighting enhancing its lush texture.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A moss-covered tree stump with a dark, hollow center and rough, textured bark visible on its side.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dried pine needles scattered across the moss, adding contrast and natural detail to the scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Moss grows densely over the stump's surface, indicating a moist, shaded forest environment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green moss with fine, feathery texture contrasts with dark, rough bark and golden-brown pine needles.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor forest setting with dappled sunlight filtering through trees, creating a serene and natural atmosphere.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two people hold hands in dimly lit parking garage, walking forward with focused expressions.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman wears white t-shirt with graphic design and blue-red cap, walking forward.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Man in white t-shirt and blue cap stands beside her, holding her hand.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: They walk side-by-side in parking garage, holding hands, suggesting connection or shared journey.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White t-shirts contrast with dark jeans and concrete floor, under harsh fluorescent lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Underground parking garage with concrete walls, fluorescent lights, and parked cars in background.

codebook_texts.C_global: A plush white cat costume with yellow horn stands on stage under spotlight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Costumed performer in white cat outfit with horn and brown strap.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White hat lies on floor near square outline, against dark curtain backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Costume character stands upright, facing away, with shadow cast on stage floor.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft white fabric, brown leather strap, yellow horn, dark curtain texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor stage performance with black floor, spotlight, and dark curtain background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Beach scene shows discarded plastic bottle and dead fish near ocean waves under cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Plastic bottle with colorful label lies partially buried in wet sand near shoreline.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dead fish with dark fins rests on sand, positioned beside the plastic bottle.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bottle and fish are side by side on beach, with ocean waves washing nearby.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Wet sand appears beige and grainy, bottle label has bright yellow and green hues.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal environment with overcast sky, gentle waves, and sandy beach terrain.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two stacks of wedding invitations rest on a dark wooden table surface.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Stack of teal invitations with embossed floral design and printed names.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Stack of yellow envelopes with purple label and handwritten names.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Invitations and envelopes are arranged side by side, suggesting preparation for an event.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Teal paper with matte finish, yellow envelope with smooth texture, and dark wood grain background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with warm ambient lighting and dark wooden table surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Misty lake surrounded by forested hills, viewed from wet wooden deck under overhanging branches.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Wooden railing and benches line the wet deck overlooking calm, mist-covered water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense green trees border the lake, fading into hazy, rolling hills in the distance.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Deck overlooks still water, with foliage framing the view and mist softening the horizon.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Damp wood, muted greens, grayish water, and soft white mist create a cool, textured atmosphere.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor lakeside scene on a foggy, overcast day with wet surfaces and subdued natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of intricate frost patterns forming delicate crystalline structures on a cold surface.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Frozen crystalline formations exhibit complex branching and feathery textures across the frame.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark recessed areas contrast with bright, glittering frost highlights scattered throughout the scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Frost patterns appear static, layered, and densely packed, suggesting a prolonged freezing process.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Cool blue and white tones dominate, with granular, sparkling textures and sharp crystalline edges.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter scene under diffuse lighting, likely on a glass pane or metal surface covered in frost.

codebook_texts.C_global: A smiling woman stands in front of a vibrant, colorful mural with abstract and cultural designs.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman with short dark hair, wearing a red top and patterned scarf, smiles at the camera.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large, stylized figure with green and red patterns appears in the mural behind her.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The woman poses confidently, standing close to the wall, with her hands slightly in her pockets.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant reds, greens, blues, and yellows with textured collage elements and layered paint strokes.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor urban art space with mixed-media wall art, artificial lighting, and artistic ambiance.

codebook_texts.C_global: White vintage car parked on cobblestone street with modern vehicles nearby.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Compact white Fiat 500 with rounded body, chrome hubcaps, and classic design.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark-colored cars parked behind the white car, with a blue vehicle visible in the background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Car is stationary on a paved street, positioned near a sidewalk and utility pole.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White paint with slight wear, black tires, and textured cobblestone pavement under sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene with bright daylight, concrete buildings, and parked vehicles.

codebook_texts.C_global: A close-up of a fuzzy jumping spider perched on a green leaf with blurred background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The spider has large black eyes, hairy legs, and a textured body with dark markings.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The leaf beneath the spider shows small brown specks and a slightly rough surface texture.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The spider is positioned front-facing, appearing alert and stationary on the leaf surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The spider's fur is light gray with dark brown patterns, contrasting with the leaf's green hue.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting with soft, diffused lighting and shallow depth of field background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Young girl in vibrant traditional attire sits smiling while holding decorative pot indoors.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Child with dark hair in braids, wearing ornate orange and blue patterned dress.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Large hand-painted ceramic pot with green and gold designs held by the girl.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Girl seated on small wooden stool, positioned near sofa with red cushion behind.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange fabric with intricate blue diamond patterns and white bead-like embellishments.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with light-colored walls, speckled floor, and wooden furniture under soft lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant red shrine gate illuminated at night with glowing lanterns and intricate wooden architecture.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Grand traditional Japanese torii gate with ornate carvings and vertical hanging lanterns.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Yellow lantern with bear motif and glowing red lantern with Japanese characters hanging nearby.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lanterns hang symmetrically from gate beams, casting warm light on stone pavement below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich red lacquered wood, golden accents, glowing yellow lanterns, and dark textured roof tiles.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime scene at a Japanese shrine with artificial lighting and blurred pedestrian motion.

codebook_texts.C_global: Large blue banner with 'LIFE' text stands behind scattered debris and broken items under bright daylight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Prominent blue banner displays bold, beige letters spelling 'LIFE' against a vivid sky background.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Broken furniture, cardboard boxes, and metal scraps lie scattered across the foreground ground surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Debris is piled haphazardly in front of the banner, suggesting abandonment or demolition site.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue fabric with matte texture contrasts with beige lettering and metallic debris surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene under clear, bright daylight with visible sky and industrial debris background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Lighthouse stands tall over ocean at twilight, surrounded by palm trees and resort lights.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall cylindrical lighthouse with glowing top, illuminated against darkening sky.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Palm trees and resort buildings with glowing lights line the beachfront.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lighthouse overlooks calm ocean, with resort pools and pathways below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blue ocean, purple sky, warm yellow lights, and green palm fronds.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Coastal resort scene at dusk with clear sky, calm sea, and artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Protesters run through smoke-filled urban street amid scattered debris and broken barriers.
