codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cars are arranged vertically in a sculpture, not functional, in a large open parking area.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm sunset hues, metallic car surfaces, concrete ground, and cloudy sky with soft gradients.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor parking lot at dusk, with scattered streetlights, commercial buildings, and open sky.

codebook_texts.C_global: Golden crown adorned statue stands solemnly in stone-walled church interior.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Statue of religious figure wears ornate red robe and lace veil with intricate embroidery.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows textured stone wall with warm ambient lighting casting soft shadows.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Figure gazes upward with hands clasped, positioned centrally under radiant crown.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich reds, golds, and deep blacks with lace, embroidery, and metallic sheen textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor religious setting with dim, warm lighting and ancient stone architecture.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white photo captures rainy European street with pedestrians holding umbrellas.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Pedestrians walk down narrow alleyway, some holding umbrellas for shelter.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Old stone buildings with ornate architectural details line both sides of the street.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People navigate wet pavement under overcast sky, moving away from camera's viewpoint.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight rough stone textures and wet reflective surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban alleyway scene under rainy weather with diffused natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Monochrome architectural structure under cloudy sky with industrial chimneys in background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Concrete building with angular design, multiple windows, and elevated base.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Three tall smokestacks rise behind the building, suggesting nearby industrial activity.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Building appears static and unused, with empty plaza and distant tables under umbrellas.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Gray concrete surfaces, smooth and weathered, contrasted with dark shadows and cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene under overcast weather, with paved plaza and sparse human presence.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vintage blue station wagon parked inside a spacious industrial warehouse with high ceilings and large windows.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Classic blue station wagon with sleek lines, chrome trim, and vintage wheel design.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Industrial-style overhead lights and large multi-paned windows in the warehouse background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Car is stationary, positioned parallel to the warehouse wall under artificial lighting.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth metallic blue paint, black rubber tires, and reflective chrome accents on wheels and trim.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor warehouse setting with exposed beams, concrete floor, and diffused natural light from windows.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunset casts golden glow over urban skyline with bridge and rooftops in foreground.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Sun partially obscured by clouds, emitting soft light over cityscape.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Steel truss bridge spans across water, connecting distant city districts.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Buildings stand in rows behind rooftops, with vehicles moving along roads below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange and yellow hues blend with muted grays and brick textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban landscape at dusk under hazy sky with soft ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Overcast sky looms over highway intersection with faded road signs and distant buildings.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Green rectangular highway signs with white lettering indicate State Hwy 184 at a roadside junction.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Traffic lights hang above the road, one red and one green, signaling vehicle movement.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Signs are mounted on a metal pole, positioned at a street corner with blurred background structures.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Weathered green signs with bold white text contrast against gray pavement and muted earth tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor roadside scene under cloudy skies, with dry vegetation and commercial buildings in the distance.

codebook_texts.C_global: A slice of chocolate dessert with raspberries and mint on a pale green plate.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Rectangular chocolate cake slice with smooth top and crumbly base.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Fresh raspberries, a mint leaf, and a dark chocolate sphere as garnish.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dessert slice arranged on plate with toppings positioned atop the cake.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich dark brown chocolate, vibrant red raspberries, and green mint leaf.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft lighting and wooden background surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman smiles while holding a playful cat on her lap in a cozy indoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A small cat lies on its back with paws up, appearing relaxed and content.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred woman in white tank top sits behind the cat, hands gently resting on her lap.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cat rests comfortably on woman's lap, suggesting affectionate interaction and calm bonding.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight soft fur textures and smooth fabric surfaces in the scene.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor domestic environment with soft lighting and neutral background elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Pigeons perch in orderly rows along overhead wires against a pale blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Dark-feathered pigeons sit calmly, silhouetted against the sky on electrical wires.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large, round, yellowish streetlight fixture hangs below the lower wire cluster.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Birds are arranged in two parallel lines, spaced evenly along the wires.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, matte gray wires contrast with the soft blue gradient of the sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting under clear, bright daylight with no visible clouds.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunlit poolside lounge area overlooks calm ocean under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large beige umbrella shades wooden lounge chairs beside pool edge.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Weathered ceramic vase stands on grass near pool's tiled border.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lounge chairs arranged parallel to pool, facing ocean horizon.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm yellow tones contrast with teal water and textured ceramic vase.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor tropical resort setting with bright daylight and ocean backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: A small motorboat rests peacefully on calm water during golden hour sunset.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: White and green striped boat with outboard motor attached to stern.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Ropes securing the boat to unseen mooring points in tranquil water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Boat is stationary, anchored, and reflects warm light on still surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange glow contrasts with deep blue water and boat's weathered paint.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal scene at dusk with serene, reflective water and soft ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunflower stands tall against sunset sky, silhouetted field behind, warm golden glow fading.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Single sunflower with bright yellow petals and dark center, facing right, stem visible.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Silhouetted cornfield in background, distant horizon line, faint clouds above.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Sunflower positioned right foreground, sun setting behind field, creating backlight effect.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow petals, dark brown center, green leaves, gradient sky from orange to blue.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural field at dusk, clear sky, warm ambient lighting from setting sun.

codebook_texts.C_global: A man with a beard has a bright green plastic lizard perched on his lips and chin.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A small, vivid green lizard with textured scales and detailed limbs is positioned near a man's mouth.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The man's facial hair and red lips frame the lizard, with a blurred background behind him.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The lizard is resting on the man's chin and lower lip, appearing to be held or placed there.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green lizard with white speckled patterns, contrasting with the man's reddish skin and dark beard.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with warm lighting, showing a close-up of the man's face and the lizard.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dandelion fluff blooms in vibrant green meadow under bright blue sky with distant cityscape and mountains.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: White, spherical dandelion seed heads stand tall in foreground grass with delicate, feathery seeds.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall slender trees with sparse green leaves rise behind the meadow near paved path and urban skyline.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Fluffy dandelions rest on grassy slope while city buildings and mountains frame the scenic background.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green grass, soft white dandelion fluff, blue sky with fluffy clouds, and distant gray city structures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor park scene on sunny day with clear weather, distant urban skyline, and mountain range backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: A man stares intensely at the camera in a dramatic black-and-white portrait.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A man with short hair and stubble wears a plain t-shirt, gazing directly forward.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The background is dark and blurred, emphasizing the subject's facial features and expression.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The subject's intense gaze and close-up framing create a confrontational and focused composition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast monochrome tones highlight skin texture, stubble, and fabric weave of the shirt.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor studio setting with directional lighting casting strong shadows on the subject’s face.

codebook_texts.C_global: White circular copyright symbol on glass window with blurred interior background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large white copyright symbol with rounded circle enclosing a capital C.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Faint reflection of person and warm lighting visible behind the symbol.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Symbol is affixed to glass surface, viewed from outside looking in.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth matte white material contrasts with dark glass and warm ambient tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft lighting, likely commercial or office space viewed through glass.

codebook_texts.C_global: Aerial view of densely packed rooftops with varied materials and colors in urban setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Roof structures with corrugated metal, shingles, and flat panels arranged in tight clusters.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blue corrugated metal roof section contrasting with surrounding red and brown surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Rooftops are tightly packed, overlapping, and arranged in irregular patterns from above.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich reds, browns, blues, and grays with metallic sheen and rough textured surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban rooftop scene under bright daylight with clear visibility and no weather effects.

codebook_texts.C_global: Minimalist art piece hangs on plain wall in quiet gallery space with soft lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Square-framed artwork with concentric yellow and brown squares layered within.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Smooth gray wall surface and light-colored floor create clean, uncluttered background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Artwork is mounted at eye level, centered on wall, with ample negative space around it.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow and muted brown tones contrast with neutral gray wall and floor textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor gallery setting with even, diffused lighting and minimalist architectural elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man in navy blazer and khaki pants takes photo with digital camera at outdoor gathering.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Man wearing glasses, navy blazer with gold buttons, and beige trousers holding camera.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Woman in white jacket and skirt carries pink handbag with black camera slung over shoulder.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Man and woman stand close, both holding cameras, suggesting shared photographic interest.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Light beige trousers, navy blazer with gold buttons, and pink handbag with smooth leather texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor grassy area with green trees in background under bright natural daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Fisheye lens captures giant spider sculpture dominating plaza near modern architecture under cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large black spider sculpture with long spindly legs and detailed body structure stands prominently.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Curved stone building with geometric patterns and distant people walking on paved plaza.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Spider sculpture positioned centrally, viewed from low angle with fisheye distortion emphasizing scale.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark matte spider contrasts with light gray stone textures and muted sky tones under diffuse lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban plaza with modern architectural elements, overcast weather, and wide open space.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person seated on public transport wearing fluffy boots and carrying a backpack.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person wearing beige boots with white fur trim and a beige backpack.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blue patterned bag and red string tied to backpack strap.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person sitting next to another passenger on a crowded transit vehicle.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Beige suede boots, white fluffy trim, metallic gold sequined fabric, and blue patterned bag.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor public transit setting with gray floor, metal bench, and dim artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Weathered wooden shed stands alone in barren woods, surrounded by dry grass and leafless trees.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Rustic A-frame shed with broken windows, open door, and visible interior clutter.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red tractor sits outside, hanging tools, and a baseball bat mounted on the door.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Shed door ajar reveals dark interior, while tractor rests nearby on ground.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Weathered gray wood, rusty red metal, and faded blue plastic against dry brown earth.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural scene in late autumn or winter, under clear blue sky with bare trees.

codebook_texts.C_global: Fluffy white kitten sits on blue fabric, looking directly at camera with curious expression.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tiny kitten has round face, large dark eyes, and soft white fur with slight pinkish hue.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blue textured fabric beneath kitten provides contrast to its fluffy white coat.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Kitten appears stationary, gazing forward, positioned centrally in frame with shallow depth of field.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft white fur with subtle peach undertones, dark eyes, and deep blue background fabric.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with dim ambient lighting, dark teal wall behind, and cozy fabric surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: A delicate butterfly perches on vivid purple flowers against a soft green backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The butterfly displays gray wings with black spots and orange-tipped hindwings.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vibrant magenta petals form a textured floral cluster beneath the butterfly.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The insect is stationary, gripping the flower with its slender legs and antennae.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft gray wings contrast with bright magenta petals and subtle green foliage.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene with natural daylight illuminating the butterfly and flowers.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person holds Morrissey album cover over face in plain indoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Individual wearing light blue long-sleeved shirt with graphic design.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Album cover features portrait of man with text 'Morrissey' and 'Viva Hate'.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person uses album as mask, hand partially visible near face.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft beige wall, muted blue shirt, textured fabric, and printed album cover.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor scene with neutral lighting, plain wall background, and no windows visible.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant crocheted textile with flowing patterns rests on a pale surface, showcasing intricate craftsmanship.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Handcrafted knitted fabric displays swirling, leaf-like motifs with gradient hues of pink and orange.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Soft, light-colored background provides contrast to the vividly colored textured foreground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Textile is laid flat, revealing its detailed structure and decorative fringe along the edges.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich gradient of magenta, fuchsia, coral, and peach tones with raised, looped yarn texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with even, diffused lighting highlighting the textile’s colors and craftsmanship.

codebook_texts.C_global: A sleek black race car speeds along a wet asphalt track, kicking up spray near a grassy barrier.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A low-slung, aerodynamic black race car with a white stripe and glowing headlights.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A white safety fence lines the track edge, with green grass beyond and a chain-link fence in the distance.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The car is cornering tightly, tires gripping the wet surface, with motion blur indicating high speed.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The car's glossy black paint contrasts with white racing stripes and reflective headlights.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: An outdoor racetrack scene under overcast lighting, with wet pavement and visible tire spray.

codebook_texts.C_global: Child wearing green inflatable ring stands on pavement, casting distinct shadow nearby.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Child's legs visible, standing barefoot while holding green inflatable ring overhead.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark wooden deck structure appears in upper right corner of the scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person stands upright, casting elongated shadow on ground beneath them.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green plastic ring contrasts with gray textured pavement surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor paved area under bright sunlight, casting sharp shadows and clear details.

codebook_texts.C_global: Powerful ocean waves crash violently against a lighthouse during a stormy coastal scene.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Red and white striped lighthouse stands tall with a black top and metal railing.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rough, dark rocks form a breakwater behind the lighthouse, partially submerged by waves.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Waves surge forward, splashing high around the lighthouse base and rocks.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blue sky contrasts with white foam, red stripes, and grayish wet rocks.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Stormy coastal environment with dramatic lighting and turbulent sea conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: Monochrome close-up of a car door handle recessed into a smooth, curved surface.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A sleek, elongated handle with a glossy finish embedded in a curved panel.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Soft shadows cast by the handle and surrounding curved wall structure.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Handle is recessed and flush with the car's body, suggesting modern automotive design.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, matte gray surfaces contrast with the glossy handle and soft shadow gradients.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or controlled lighting environment with monochrome tones and minimal background detail.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman with a camera stands against a graffiti-covered wall with peeling paint.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman with dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a red top and black pants.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A black camera held in her arms, with a strap over her shoulder.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She stands sideways, gazing right, positioned near a weathered wall with graffiti.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Worn white and yellow wall with black spray-painted text and stars, peeling texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban outdoor setting with graffiti-covered, deteriorating wall under natural daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of delicate purple flower cluster against soft green blurred background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tiny lavender petals with slender stamens radiating from central green stem.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Out-of-focus green foliage forms a natural backdrop behind the blossoms.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Petals and stamens arranged in dense spherical cluster, viewed from above.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft lavender hues contrast with muted greens, creating velvety textured appearance.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene under diffused natural light, with shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Anime-style figurine stands amidst autumn leaves against a solid green backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Figurine wears yellow dress with white bow, holding curved blade in dynamic pose.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Brown fallen leaves scatter around base, adding seasonal atmosphere to scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Figurine positioned upright, weapon held at side, suggesting readiness or display stance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange and yellow fabric contrasts with white accents and earthy leaf textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Controlled studio setting with uniform green background and soft directional lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Field notes notebooks rest on wooden surface beside writing tools.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two tan field notes memo books with black text and white circular sticker.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black pen and wooden pencil lie beside the notebooks on wood.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Notebooks are open and positioned for use, tools nearby for writing.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm wood grain background, matte tan paper, smooth black ink text.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor tabletop setting with natural lighting and organized workspace.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow-dusted fields stretch toward distant snow-capped mountains under pale sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Snow-capped mountain range dominates horizon with jagged peaks and soft slopes.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Sparse trees and utility towers line the midground near a blue-roofed barn.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flat snowy field lies in foreground, with mountains rising far behind in layered depth.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Pale blue sky, white snow, muted brown earth, and grayish metallic structures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Cold winter rural landscape with overcast lighting and distant mountain backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Colorful letter blocks spell 'WHERE ARE YOU' across a vast desert under a partly cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Multicolored square blocks with letters arranged in a row on poles in the sand.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White plastic bins placed beneath each letter block, anchored in the desert floor.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Letters are spaced apart, mounted on poles, forming a question across the open landscape.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Brightly colored blocks contrast with pale sandy ground and distant gray mountains.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Open desert environment with distant mountains, clear blue sky, and scattered clouds.

codebook_texts.C_global: Stylized Mickey Mouse head with tribal patterns on textured brown background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Circular ears and central face form iconic mouse silhouette with intricate flame-like designs.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows cracked, weathered surface with mottled earthy tones and subtle grain.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Design is centrally positioned, symmetrically balanced with no motion or interaction depicted.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich orange, black, and red hues contrast with rough, aged, rust-colored surface texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Artistic graphic composition on a rustic, aged backdrop suggesting vintage or fantasy theme.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant street parade features costumed performers dancing in front of urban buildings under clear skies.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A performer in ornate white and blue costume with red headdress dances energetically with a staff.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background includes onlookers, umbrellas, and a rickshaw near weathered residential buildings.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dancers move in formation across brick pavement, interacting with spectators and each other.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich patterns of gold, blue, red, and white with glossy fabric textures and intricate embroidery.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor daytime street performance under bright sunlight with clear blue sky and urban surroundings.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow-capped mountains rise under a twilight sky with soft pastel hues blending above rugged peaks.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Sharp, jagged mountain peaks covered in snow dominate the horizon with dramatic silhouettes.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Foreground terrain shows patchy snow over brown grassy slopes leading to distant ridges.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Mountains stand still as the sun sets, casting long shadows and illuminating the sky in gradient tones.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth snow contrasts with rough earthy textures, while sky transitions from purple to peach and orange.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Alpine landscape at dusk with clear weather, showcasing natural mountainous terrain under fading daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: White bird soars mid-air near people in a dimly lit outdoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Elegant white bird with outstretched wings and long black legs.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred figures of people in yellow and blue clothing behind the bird.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bird appears to be landing or taking off near wooden railings and visitors.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Contrasting white feathers, dark legs, and muted background tones with wooden textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene with artificial lighting, wooden railings, and blurred human presence.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person stands on sandy beach watching vibrant sunset over calm ocean waters under dramatic clouds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person wearing red jacket and dark pants, standing upright facing the horizon.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White dog lying on sand near person, partially shaded by surrounding vegetation.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person and dog are positioned together on beach, gazing toward setting sun across water.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blues and purples in sky contrast with fiery orange and yellow hues near horizon.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Coastal beach scene at dusk with cloudy sky, wet sand, and distant land silhouette.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two people stand before a doorway in a weathered turquoise building, observing something inside.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A person wearing a white cowboy hat and bright pink vest stands with hands raised near a door.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A man in a white t-shirt with red circular logo stands beside the woman, facing the doorway.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The individuals appear to be peering into a dimly lit interior space through an open doorway.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The wall shows faded turquoise paint with peeling texture and graffiti, contrasting with the vibrant pink vest.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene with aged architecture, natural daylight, and visible sidewalk pavement.

codebook_texts.C_global: Folded quilt with colorful bird patterns rests on a white bedspread.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Stylized birds with patterned wings and bodies are embroidered on fabric.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red and orange zigzag patterns appear on some bird shapes and fabric edges.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Birds are arranged in scattered positions across the quilt's surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Fabric has textured stitching, vibrant reds, blues, and orange patterns.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft lighting, showing a cozy bedding arrangement.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman in white dress holds violin against dark velvet curtain backdrop in studio setting.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Tracks follow a smooth, sweeping arc, suggesting motion and directional flow.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark gray cobblestones contrast with shiny metallic rails and sunlit highlights.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene with strong directional lighting and clear shadows.

codebook_texts.C_global: Winding road curves through vibrant green trees and golden-yellow field under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall trees with lush green leaves line the asphalt road, some with white-painted trunks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vast field of bright yellow flowers stretches across the horizon behind the trees.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Road gently bends to the right, flanked by trees and bordered by grassy verge.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green foliage, golden-yellow flowers, smooth gray asphalt, and clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural landscape on a sunny day with clear weather and open fields.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow-capped mountain reflects perfectly in calm lake surrounded by dense evergreen forest under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Pyramidal snow-covered mountain peak rises sharply against horizon with visible glacier textures.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark green coniferous trees line the shoreline, their reflections mirrored in still water surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Mountain stands still while its reflection appears symmetrical across tranquil lake surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth dark water contrasts with white snow, deep green foliage, and pale blue sky with soft cloud edges.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural landscape under bright daylight with clear weather and serene mountain lake setting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Bride in white gown and veil views herself in bathroom mirrors with brick wall backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Bride wearing strapless dress, veil, and pearl necklace gazes at her reflection.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Three mirrors mounted on tiled wall reflect bride and brick-patterned wall sections.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bride stands before mirrors in tiled restroom, viewing her reflection in multiple frames.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White tiles, blue brick pattern, and metallic mirror frames create contrasting textures and hues.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor bathroom with tiled walls, brick accents, and bright artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A young child gazes downward with a solemn expression in a monochrome portrait.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Child with dark hair, adorned with beaded headpieces, stares intently downward.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background is blurred, emphasizing the child's face and traditional attire details.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Child's head is slightly tilted, eyes focused downward, suggesting contemplation or sadness.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black and white tones highlight skin texture and beaded patterns.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or shaded setting with shallow depth of field, creating intimate portrait lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunset bathes rusted submarine in golden light, floating serenely on calm waters.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Rusted submarine with visible hull damage and conning tower, partially submerged.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wavy water surface reflecting sky's warm tones and sun's bright glow.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Submarine rests motionless on water, positioned centrally under dramatic sky.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich golden hues, metallic rust textures, and shimmering water reflections dominate.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor maritime scene at golden hour, with dramatic clouds and tranquil water.

codebook_texts.C_global: A beige box-like structure stands on a stone pedestal in a grassy outdoor area under cloudy skies.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A beige, house-shaped box with a sloped roof sits atop a weathered stone pedestal with carved reliefs.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A gravel path runs behind the pedestal, bordered by green grass and a distant hedge.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The structure is positioned centrally on the grass, elevated on a multi-tiered stone base.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Beige smooth surface contrasts with mossy, textured stone and green grass under diffused lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor park or garden setting with overcast sky, trees in background, and natural daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Grand cathedral interior with vaulted ceilings, stained glass windows, and warm artificial lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: High vaulted ceiling with ribbed Gothic architecture and intersecting stone arches.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Stained glass windows with colorful patterns and arched frames along the walls.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Light beams illuminate the space from above, highlighting architectural symmetry and depth.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Stone surfaces show aged texture, warm golden lights, and vibrant hues from stained glass.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor religious building with Gothic architectural style, dim ambient lighting, and ornate details.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vintage blue scooter rests against weathered wall beside wooden door in sunlit alleyway.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Blue scooter with chrome accents and worn seat leans against textured wall.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red wooden door with glass panels and peeling paint stands beside cobblestone path.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Scooter is parked near doorway, casting shadow on stone pavement under bright sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm ochre walls, rusty red door, vibrant blue scooter, and rough cobblestone ground.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban alley with aged architecture, bright daylight, and textured stone surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_global: A street performer in shiny uniform sings into microphone near stone wall.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person wearing reflective silver outfit and glasses, gesturing while singing.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black suitcase with poster, wire stand, and bucket on sidewalk.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Performer stands before microphone, audience implied by setup and props.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome image with metallic sheen, rough stone, and textured pavement.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street performance near historic stone building under daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Warmly lit dining scene with beer glasses and pizza plates on a dark table.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall glass filled with golden beer, condensation droplets visible on its surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurry background shows people eating and another beer glass on the table.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Beer glasses sit beside pizza plates, suggesting a casual dining gathering.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich amber hues, glossy wet surfaces, and soft blurred background textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor restaurant setting with dim, warm ambient lighting and wooden table surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_global: Circular dome ceiling with geometric patterns and central skylight illuminates the space below.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Central skylight with glass panes and metal frame, surrounded by concentric rings.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Geometric coffered panels form the dome's surface, radiating outward from the skylight.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Light beams descend from the skylight, casting patterns across the dome’s interior structure.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm beige tones with metallic accents, smooth surfaces, and subtle shadows from recessed panels.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor architectural space with high ceiling, artificial lighting, and classical design elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant red-brick church stands beside calm pond under dramatic sky with fluffy clouds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall pointed-roof church with arched windows and stone foundation near water's edge.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Lush green trees with pink flowering bushes frame the scene along the waterbank.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Church reflection mirrors perfectly in still pond, surrounded by dense foliage.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich red brick, emerald green leaves, and soft white clouds contrast vividly against blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scenic landscape with bright daylight, partly cloudy weather, and tranquil water setting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A bride and groom pose dramatically in a dilapidated, abandoned building with peeling walls.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A bride in a voluminous white gown sits on the floor, holding her bouquet.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A groom in a white suit leans out of a broken window frame above her.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The bride reaches upward toward the groom, who gestures back from the window ledge.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Worn concrete, faded green paint, and distressed plaster contrast with the bride's pristine white dress.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor, abandoned structure with exposed walls, dim lighting, and a gritty, urban decay aesthetic.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man and woman playfully interact with large box in empty room with windows.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Man in blue shirt and jeans leans forward holding cardboard box.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Woman in pink sleeves sits inside large white box labeled 'Mazzer'.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Man assists woman as she sits in box, both laughing and enjoying playful moment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Blue denim, pink sleeves, white box with red lettering, and teal carpeted floor.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with large windows, exposed wiring, and empty room with artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A skateboarder mid-air above a ramp while a woman sits nearby in a skatepark.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman in a white crop top and black bikini bottoms sitting on a wooden ledge.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A skateboarder wearing a helmet and white shirt performing a trick over a green ramp.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The skateboarder is airborne, executing a trick while the woman watches from the side.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Green graffiti-covered ramp, wooden textures, and natural outdoor lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor skatepark with trees, wooden structures, and bright daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person stands surrounded by glowing orbs in a dark, immersive, colorful light installation.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Silhouette of a person wearing a glowing blue top, facing away from the camera.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Numerous floating spheres in green, yellow, and orange hues scattered throughout the space.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person appears to be observing or interacting with the suspended glowing orbs in a suspended environment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant neon green, yellow, and blue lights contrast against the pitch-black background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor art installation with black walls and ceiling, illuminated by UV-reactive lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow-covered village under dark sky with colorful fireworks exploding overhead.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Wooden houses with snow-laden roofs and glowing windows in foreground.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant city lights and scattered firework bursts illuminating the night horizon.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Fireworks display above town while snow blankets rooftops and streets below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White snow, dark wooden textures, warm yellow window glows, and vibrant blue firework sparks.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Winter night scene with snowy landscape, artificial lighting, and festive fireworks display.

codebook_texts.C_global: A silhouette airplane flies against a vivid green sky with a glowing sun near the horizon.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A commercial jet aircraft in mid-flight, wings level, tail fin visible, dark outline.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark silhouetted treeline at the bottom, glowing circular sun partially obscured by foliage.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Airplane traverses the sky above the treeline, sun positioned low on the horizon.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green sky with smooth gradient, contrasting with black silhouette and bright yellow sun.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor aerial scene at sunrise or sunset, atmospheric lighting with saturated color tones.

codebook_texts.C_global: Modern brick building with large overhang and steps, urban plaza, pedestrian walking.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Brick-faced building with sloped metal canopy and tiered entrance steps.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Large billboard on side wall, distant high-rise buildings, parked vehicles.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person walking across plaza toward building, steps lead to glass entrance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rust-brown brick, dark metal canopy, gray concrete steps, glass windows.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban plaza under bright daylight, surrounded by city architecture.

codebook_texts.C_global: A small puppy sleeps peacefully on a colorful patterned blanket indoors.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A light brown puppy lies on its back with paws up, appearing relaxed and asleep.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A white tag attached to the puppy's collar is visible near its hind leg.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The puppy is sprawled on its back, nestled within the folds of a textured blanket.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich orange, green, and dark brown floral patterns cover the fabric surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with warm lighting, featuring a cozy blanket as the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Foggy night street with cars driving under dim yellow streetlights.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Bright headlights of multiple cars moving along a wet road.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark tree branches silhouetted against hazy, glowing streetlights.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Vehicles travel in same direction, separated by distance in foggy conditions.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Yellowish glow from lights contrasts with dark, misty, wet asphalt surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban nighttime street scene with heavy fog and artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A store window displays a humorous sign offering free police car rides for shoplifting, with a person walking past.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A yellow sign with bold black text advertising a free police car ride for shoplifting.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A person in a black tank top walking past the store window, partially visible in reflection.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The sign is affixed to a glass door with a 'PULL' handle, suggesting entry or exit.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Bright yellow background with black text, framed by red borders and cartoonish graphics.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor retail environment with glass doors, fluorescent lighting, and visible merchandise shelves.

codebook_texts.C_global: A stylized pigeon mural painted on a concrete wall beside a chain-link fence at night.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A cartoonish pigeon with oversized eyes, outlined in black, standing upright on a wall.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A metal chain-link fence and a parked car visible behind the mural.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The pigeon is depicted as stationary, positioned near a gate with urban surroundings.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic gray and white paint with rough brushstrokes on a textured concrete surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban alleyway at night, illuminated by artificial light with visible pavement and fence.

codebook_texts.C_global: An elderly woman with curly white hair sits indoors, wearing glasses and a patterned jacket.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: An older woman with short white curls, wearing round glasses and a beaded necklace.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A wooden door with panels behind her and a green bag partially visible to the right.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She is seated at a table, hands resting on a surface, possibly engaged in conversation or an event.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich red and black patterned fabric, glossy black beads, and cream-colored lace undergarment.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with neutral lighting, plain walls, and a closed wooden door in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: A glowing blue circular device sits on a dark surface, casting vibrant reflections.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A rounded black electronic device with a bright blue illuminated ring around its base.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A faint white cable and dark background elements are visible in the upper left corner.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The device emits light downward, creating symmetrical blue reflections on the glossy surface below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Intense blue glow contrasts with deep black surfaces, producing smooth, reflective textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with dim ambient lighting, emphasizing the device's luminous effect on a polished surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: A man in medieval armor stands close-up, helmet partially covering his face, with blurred background elements.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A man with a beard wears a metal helmet with a visor, showing only one eye and part of his mouth.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Behind the man, blurred red and white fabric suggests tents or banners in a historical reenactment setting.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The man's gaze is directed forward, helmet strap visible, suggesting readiness or posing for a photo.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Metallic gray helmet with worn texture, brown leather strap, and dark beard against muted background tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor historical reenactment scene with soft natural lighting and shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunlit home office setup with curved desk, ergonomic chair, and computer equipment.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Curved wooden desk with built-in shelf, supporting computer monitor and keyboard.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black leather ergonomic chair positioned under glass-paneled door with brass doorknobs.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Computer monitor displays abstract wallpaper, while speakers and photo frames sit nearby.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm wood grain, black leather, white keyboard, and golden-brown curtains with textured pattern.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Well-lit indoor workspace with natural light from glass door, carpeted floor, and window curtains.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person underwater wearing snorkel gear, smiling and waving at camera in clear blue water.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person with reddish hair, wearing blue-rimmed diving mask and snorkel, submerged in water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black snorkel tube attached to mask, visible against person's face and chest.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person holds camera for selfie, hand raised in wave, positioned near water surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Blue water with sunlit ripples, skin tones, and clear plastic mask with blue frame.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Underwater scene with bright sunlight filtering through water, clear blue background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Couple rests together on snowy hillside under bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Man and woman sit closely on snow, wearing snowshoes and winter jackets.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Sparse bushes and distant horizon line visible in background landscape.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: They lean into each other, suggesting affectionate companionship during outdoor activity.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Snow appears bright white and powdery, contrasted with dark clothing and blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter scene with clear daylight, open snowy terrain, and crisp atmospheric conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: Aerial view of active volcanic crater emitting smoke and glowing lava within rugged terrain.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Circular volcanic crater with visible molten lava and rising plume of white smoke.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Surrounding hardened lava flows and rust-colored rocky slopes frame the crater's edge.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Smoke rises from the crater while glowing lava pulses beneath the surface within the caldera.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark gray rough lava textures contrast with orange-red glowing lava and rust-brown rocky surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor volcanic landscape under natural daylight with no clouds or vegetation present.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman embraces fluffy white dog outdoors in warm, natural sunlight with blurred greenery behind.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Young woman with dark hair, smiling warmly while hugging a small white dog.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Pink and white striped sleeveless top with logo on chest worn by the woman.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Woman holds dog close to her chest, both looking toward camera with affectionate expressions.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft white fluffy fur contrasts with pink striped fabric and green blurred background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene with natural daylight, soft-focus trees, and earthy tones in background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of denim jeans resting on a person's lap with blurred background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Blue denim jeans with visible stitching and worn fabric texture.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Soft out-of-focus background with warm tones and indistinct shapes.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Jeans are positioned low on the body, suggesting relaxed posture or lying down.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Worn blue denim with faded areas, frayed edges, and textured weave pattern.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft, diffused lighting and shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two men stretch arms upward against a glass wall displaying the Facebook logo.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A man in a black shirt and gray pants leans forward with arms raised.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A man in a white shirt and blue jeans mirrors the pose beside the glass wall.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Both individuals appear to be reaching toward the Facebook logo on the glass facade.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The glass wall has a translucent green tint with white lettering and metallic frames.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with concrete pavement and modern glass architecture under daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Golden evening light casts long shadows across a park with people walking and benches.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Silhouetted figures stroll along a path, their forms dark against the glowing ground.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A row of benches sits on grass, partially illuminated by warm, low-angle sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People are scattered across the park, some walking, others seated, under tree canopies.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden hues dominate the scene, contrasting with deep shadows and textured brick pavement.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor park at dusk, featuring trees, benches, and paved walkways under soft ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Curved wooden bookshelf mounted on wall holds colorful books in unique spiral design.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Spiral-shaped dark wood shelf with multiple levels for displaying books.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Stacks of books with varied spines in red, blue, yellow, and green hues.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Books arranged along curved shelf, some standing upright, others stacked neatly.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich dark wood finish contrasts with vibrant book spines and plain white wall.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Minimalist indoor setting with bright even lighting and clean white background wall.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunlit orange hibiscus blooms behind chain-link fence in warm outdoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large, vibrant orange hibiscus flower with ruffled petals and visible stamen.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Chain-link fence in foreground, blurred background with building and foliage.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flower grows through fence, casting shadows, positioned slightly off-center.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange petals contrast with green leaves and metallic gray fence texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene under bright sunlight with clear blue sky and soft background blur.

codebook_texts.C_global: City skyline at twilight with glowing highways and illuminated buildings.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Curved elevated roadway with streaks of light from moving vehicles.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rogers Centre with its distinctive dome and blue-lit exterior.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cars flow rapidly along the highway, creating light trails against the urban backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blue sky, warm yellow streetlights, and glowing neon signage contrast with dark pavement.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban night scene with artificial lighting, high-rise structures, and clear atmospheric conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: A large bird soars through clear blue sky, wings spread wide with prey in beak.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Grey heron with long neck, sharp beak, and wide-spread wings in flight.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Small fish or crustacean clutched in bird's beak, visible against sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bird flies upward with wings fully extended, tail feathers fanned out behind.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Feathers show grey, white, and black patterns with smooth, layered textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene under bright daylight, clear blue sky with no clouds visible.

codebook_texts.C_global: Decorative silver frame encloses vibrant orange daisies growing in terracotta pots on a brick patio.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Orange daisies with dark centers bloom abundantly among green stems and leaves.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Terracotta planters and brick wall form the background behind the flowering plants.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flowers are arranged naturally within the frame, appearing to grow freely in a garden setting.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange petals contrast with deep green foliage and ornate silver frame detailing.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene under natural daylight, framed by decorative silver picture frame.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The background shows a textured green wall and a softly blurred figure with reddish lighting.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Both girls sit side by side on stone steps, casually interacting with each other and their surroundings.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green hair, black leather texture, pink fishnet tights, and bright yellow shirt contrast against gray concrete.

codebook_texts.C_global: Rolling hills covered in patchwork fields and scattered trees under cloudy skies.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Green and brown fields divided by stone walls stretch across the valley landscape.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant hills fade into misty blue tones, framed by sparse woodland in foreground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Fields are arranged in geometric patterns, separated by fences and bordered by trees.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Muted greens, browns, and grays dominate with rough stone textures and soft grassy surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rough-hewn tree trunk forms throne backrest with carved spiral patterns.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor or semi-outdoor setting with diffused lighting and neutral background.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor memorial or installation with sunlit concrete walkway and tall vertical barriers.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Man on right dons blue suit with patterned white shirt, standing beside his companion.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor corridor with recessed ceiling lights, glass doors, and polished floor tiles.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich red fabric, warm skin tones, and soft golden highlights create a textured, glowing effect.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted bird spreads wings against golden sunset framed by tall buildings.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bird perched on ledge, wings outstretched, positioned between two vertical structures.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden hues dominate sky, contrasted with dark, smooth silhouettes of bird and buildings.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban rooftop scene at golden hour, with dramatic clouds and artificial structure framing natural light.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dark surface holds blister packs with amber capsules, lit by dramatic directional lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A dense cluster of small, spiky cacti fills the frame with vibrant green and blue hues under natural light.

codebook_texts.C_global: Yellow SpongeBob stickers with various facial expressions arranged on a white surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: A narrow railway track winds through a lush green forest tunnel, surrounded by dense foliage.

codebook_texts.C_global: A hand presses against a frosted glass surface, casting a shadow in a stark, minimalist setting.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A faint, elongated shadow extends from the hand, blending into the textured white background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man with eyepatch and glasses grins widely while hat floats above his head in studio shot.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant mural swirls frame a window with air conditioner and sheer curtain.

codebook_texts.C_global: Three friends pose together in a brightly lit liquor store filled with bottles and snacks.

codebook_texts.C_global: Skateboard mid-air above pavement, casting long shadow under bright sunlight.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark rectangular ceramic pot holding soil and supporting the bonsai’s base.

codebook_texts.C_global: Child in red coat stands alone on snowy sidewalk near parked vehicles and distant trees under overcast sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Child wearing puffy red hooded jacket, dark pants, and boots, facing away from camera.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White satellite truck with large dish, people nearby, and a person in beige coat walking in background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Child stands still on sidewalk while others move around, suggesting quiet observation or waiting.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red puffer jacket contrasts with gray pavement, white snow, and muted winter tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter scene with snow patches, overcast lighting, and urban roadside environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Pirate skeleton figure with skull hat stands against colorful abstract background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Skull-faced pirate skeleton wearing tricorn hat with skull and crossbones emblem.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red bandana wrapped around skull, green palm frond visible in background.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rough textured hat, matte bone-like skull, vibrant red fabric, blurred greens and blues.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor display with artificial lighting, abstract painted backdrop, staged exhibit setting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A young woman stands in a dimly lit public transport vehicle, gazing thoughtfully ahead.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Yellow and black striped warning tape runs vertically along the vehicle's interior wall.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She holds onto a red pole with one hand while her other hand rests near her chest.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Cool greenish tones dominate the scene, with matte surfaces and subtle reflections.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor public transit setting, likely a subway or train, with artificial lighting and metal surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouette of person jumping joyfully against vibrant sunset sky with wispy clouds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Human figure mid-air with arms outstretched, legs bent, captured in dynamic leap silhouette.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark grassy horizon line with sparse vegetation silhouetted against colorful twilight sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person leaps upward with open arms, positioned centrally above ground level against sky.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Sky transitions from warm orange to cool blue, with soft wispy cloud textures and gradient hues.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor open field at dusk, featuring clear sky, natural horizon, and ambient golden-hour lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A young woman lies motionless on cobblestone pavement while two others stand nearby.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A person in a black t-shirt with pink trim and white shorts stands beside her.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The scene shows a high-angle view of people interacting on a paved outdoor surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Gray cobblestones, black clothing, and white skirt contrast with muted urban tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with stone pavement under natural daylight conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: White brick wall features graffiti text and stylized figures in urban street setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Black handwritten Italian phrase on wall reads 'il poeta sei tu che leggi...' with red 'Ibuk' below.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Stylized black-and-white cartoon figures flank the text on either side of the wall.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Graffiti art is painted on weathered brick, positioned above sidewalk and street.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White brick surface with black and red paint, showing chipped texture and aged appearance.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene with asphalt road, curb, and daylight illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: A single iridescent soap bubble floats against a blurred green background, catching light beautifully.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The bubble is spherical, translucent, and displays vibrant rainbow-like reflections on its surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The background consists of soft, out-of-focus green foliage creating a natural bokeh effect.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The bubble appears suspended in mid-air, isolated and floating without visible support or motion blur.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The surface shows shimmering hues of blue, purple, green, and yellow with a glossy, wet texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting with diffused daylight, likely in a garden or forest with lush vegetation.

codebook_texts.C_global: A giant panda sits calmly in a naturalistic enclosure, chewing bamboo with focused attention.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The panda has a round face with black ears, eye patches, and paws, contrasting white fur on its cheeks and chest.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Behind the panda, a large wooden log and scattered hay are visible in the enclosure background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The panda holds a bamboo stalk with its front paw while chewing, positioned close to the camera.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft white fur contrasts with thick black patches around eyes and ears, and rough-textured bamboo stalks.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor zoo habitat with earthy ground, natural lighting, and greenery in the distant background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant blue wall features a pink-framed window with potted plants on its balcony.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Balcony with black metal railing holds terracotta pots of green and flowering plants.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Pink window frame contrasts with blue wall, showing glass panes and wooden sill.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Plants are arranged on balcony ledge, some leaning over railing, others upright.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich cobalt blue wall, matte finish, with pink frame and rough wooden sill texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene under bright daylight, showcasing colorful architectural detail.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white photograph of people waiting on a train station platform under an overhanging roof.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman in a long coat walks away from the camera along the platform edge.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Overhead electrical wires and metal support beams frame the upper portion of the scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Passengers stand near the platform edge, some holding bags, awaiting train arrival.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast monochrome tones with smooth textures on platform surfaces and rough metallic railings.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban railway station under bright daylight with clear sky and distant city buildings.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dalmatian dog stands near graffiti-covered wall on urban street with parked cars.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Spotted Dalmatian dog with white coat and black spots, standing alertly.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Graffiti-covered yellow wall with black and blue spray-painted designs.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dog positioned beside wall, facing left, with cars parked along street behind.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Yellow wall surface with rough texture, black graffiti lines, and white dog fur.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene under overcast lighting with buildings lining the road.

codebook_texts.C_global: Modern architectural marvels contrast under overcast skies, showcasing intricate structural designs.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Left side features a blue, scalloped, curved facade with repeating wave-like panels.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Right side displays a white, lattice-like, bird's nest structure with intersecting beams.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Two distinct architectural forms stand adjacent, creating a dynamic visual juxtaposition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth blue panels contrast with stark white metallic beams, both exhibiting geometric patterns.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene under diffused lighting, with hazy sky and no visible vegetation.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunset glows through clouds over calm water, with kayak in foreground.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Red kayak nose points forward, partially submerged in rippling water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark silhouetted hills line the horizon under dramatic sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Kayak floats peacefully on water as sun sets behind distant mountains.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden light reflects on water, contrasting with dark blue and gray clouds.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor lakeside scene at dusk with cloudy sky and tranquil water surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow-covered park bench sits alone under bare trees in quiet winter landscape.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Metal bench with mesh backrest and seat, partially buried in deep snow.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Thin tree trunks rise behind bench, their branches bare against snowy ground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bench is centered in frame, surrounded by undisturbed snowdrifts and trees.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones with smooth snow texture and metallic bench surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter park scene under overcast sky with soft diffused lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A doll in a blue polka dot dress stands on a red wooden railing outdoors.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A doll with black hair, wearing a straw hat and lace-trimmed dress, poses with hands near face.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White railing behind the doll, green foliage, and brick building in the background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The doll is positioned upright on a railing, facing forward with a calm, posed stance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Light blue fabric with white polka dots, white lace trim, and straw texture on the hat.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene with natural daylight, greenery, and residential structures in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Aerial view of lush golf course with water hazards, scattered clouds, and distant city skyline under bright daylight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Golfers on fairway near wooden bridge crossing narrow water channel surrounded by green grass.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White sand bunkers dotting the landscape, with palm trees lining the horizon behind the course.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Players walking along path beside bridge, some carrying clubs, others standing near water's edge.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green grass, deep blue sky with fluffy white clouds, and reflective water surface with subtle ripples.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor recreational golf course under clear, sunny weather with scattered cumulus clouds overhead.

codebook_texts.C_global: Red heart-shaped object rests on weathered wooden bench under natural daylight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Heart-shaped item crafted from textured red material with string attached.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark gray wooden planks with visible grain, screws, and water stains.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Heart lies stationary on bench, string trails off-frame, suggesting abandonment or offering.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red against muted gray wood, rough fibrous texture on heart, smooth plank surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor wooden bench setting, likely park or garden, under diffused natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white photo of wall-mounted clock showing time in monochrome setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Circular analog clock with black face, white numerals, and metallic rim.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Soft shadow cast by clock on wall, and partial view of electrical outlet below.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Clock hands indicate time, positioned near 5 and 7, suggesting late afternoon.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth matte wall surface, high contrast between dark clock and light background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor room with neutral lighting, plain wall, and minimalistic decor style.

codebook_texts.C_global: Butterfly rests on glass disc amid rocky terrain, sunbeams pierce water above.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Monarch butterfly with orange wings and black veins perched on transparent sphere.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rough-textured rocks surround the glass disc, with bubbles floating in water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Insect positioned centrally, sunlight refracts through water above its habitat.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange and black wing patterns contrast with blue-tinted glass and gray stone.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Aquatic enclosure with naturalistic rock background, illuminated by direct sunlight.

codebook_texts.C_global: A young woman with a joyful, slightly mischievous expression smiles warmly at the camera in a cozy indoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a headband, leans forward with a playful grin.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: She wears a white t-shirt under a dark blue patterned top with visible straps.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Her face is close to the camera, suggesting an intimate, candid moment captured indoors.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm lighting highlights her skin, while the blue top has a textured, possibly velvet-like surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: The background is softly blurred with neutral beige tones, indicating an indoor, casually lit environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two women sit on a couch knitting, showing contrasting expressions in a cozy living room setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman on left with furrowed brow, holding knitting needles and yarn, wearing striped socks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Three framed pictures hang on the wall behind them, featuring abstract art and window views.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Both women are seated side by side, each focused on knitting, with one appearing frustrated.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft beige walls, dark brown couch, blue jeans, and colorful striped socks add visual contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor living room with natural light filtering through blinds, creating a calm domestic atmosphere.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white photo captures person's head tilted back, evoking contemplative or emotional state.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark, out-of-focus background suggests shallow depth of field, emphasizing subject’s form.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Head is tilted upward, suggesting introspection, surrender, or emotional release.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic tones highlight skin texture and hair contrast, with soft gradients and shadows.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or dimly lit setting with soft lighting, creating intimate and moody atmosphere.

codebook_texts.C_global: A radiant, fiery orb pulses with intense light against a pitch-black void, creating a dramatic cosmic spectacle.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A spherical, glowing structure with intricate, fractured patterns radiating outward from its core.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A dark, circular aperture at the center emits a bright, twisted light, surrounded by jagged, glowing fragments.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Light bursts outward in radial streaks from the central core, suggesting explosive energy or motion.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant oranges, yellows, and deep reds dominate, with rough, crystalline textures and glowing edges.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: An abstract, high-contrast scene with intense artificial lighting against a complete black background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Group of young women in white outfits posing outdoors at a lively event.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Women wearing matching white crop tops, shorts, and tall boots.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Green beverage bottle held by one woman, visible tattoos on skin.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Women standing in a line, slightly angled, holding drinks and smiling.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Bright white fabric, glossy boots, and vibrant green bottle against neutral pavement.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with glass buildings, palm trees, and daylight illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted church towers rise against dramatic sky with swirling clouds and bright sunbeams.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall leafless trees frame the lower right, adding depth to the composition.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Church structure stands prominently against sky, viewed from low angle emphasizing height.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue sky contrasts with white clouds and deep black silhouette textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor religious architecture scene under dynamic daylight with partly cloudy weather.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man with glasses and beard sits alone at dimly lit bar, drinking dark beer.
