codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange glow, dark wood surfaces, textured sweater, and smoky ambiance.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor bar setting with low lighting, cozy atmosphere, and reflective surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white photo shows weathered padlock securing rusty metal structure in dim outdoor setting.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vertical metal pole and horizontal rail frame the scene with blurred background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Padlock is locked onto pipe, suggesting security or abandonment in static scene.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight rough, corroded textures and worn surfaces of metal objects.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor industrial or urban environment with shallow depth of field and soft lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black-and-white photo captures crowd gathered behind row of beer cans at dimly lit venue.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People are seated or standing behind a barrier, observing something out of frame.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast monochrome tones emphasize rough brick texture and smooth can surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor nighttime setting with artificial lighting and exposed ceiling beams overhead.

codebook_texts.C_global: White cake stand holds pastries on wooden counter in bakery setting.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Pastries arranged for display, suggesting bakery or café service.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth white ceramic, golden-brown pastry, and dark wood grain textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor bakery or café with warm lighting and wooden furniture.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of a yellow iris flower glowing with soft sunlight filtering through delicate petals.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Yellow iris petals curve gracefully inward, framing a vibrant orange stamen cluster at the center.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background is softly blurred with golden-yellow tones, enhancing the flower's vivid details.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Petals overlap and arch around the central stamen, creating a layered, symmetrical floral composition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm yellow hues blend with orange stamen, featuring smooth, translucent petal surfaces with subtle veining.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting with diffused sunlight, creating a serene and luminous floral portrait.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime view of Louvre Museum with glowing glass pyramid and historic stone buildings.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Glass pyramid structure with triangular facets and internal illumination.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Grand classical architecture with domes, columns, and arched windows along the courtyard.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Pyramid stands centrally in front of museum, surrounded by open plaza and few visitors.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden lighting contrasts with dark night sky and textured stone pavement.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban plaza at night, illuminated by artificial lights under clear sky.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two flies mating on a plain surface under soft lighting, captured in macro detail.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Top fly has large red eyes, hairy body, and transparent wings, positioned atop the other.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Bottom fly is partially obscured, showing legs and wings, with red eyes visible.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: One fly is mounted on the other, indicating mating behavior in close proximity.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Red eyes, dark textured bodies, and translucent wings with fine hairs and veins.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Minimalist indoor setting with neutral gray background and even diffused lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A lone dog stands near a doorway on a gritty urban sidewalk under stark shadows.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A slender dog with pointed ears and alert posture stands on a sidewalk.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A small white plastic stool sits abandoned beside the dog near a doorway.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The dog stands still while shadows stretch across the pavement and wall.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black-and-white tones highlight rough concrete and weathered surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street scene with cracked pavement, graffiti, and harsh directional lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted trees stand against a vibrant sunset sky with gradient hues.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant horizon glows with fiery orange and red tones behind the trees.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Trees are arranged in a staggered formation, creating depth and contrast against the sky.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Sky transitions from deep blue to warm orange, with smooth gradients and soft textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor landscape at dusk, featuring clear skies and natural lighting from a setting sun.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vibrant graffiti art with bold swirls and spray-painted letters decorates the concrete wall behind.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vivid yellows, blues, and reds contrast with the rippling water and pebbled shoreline texture.

codebook_texts.C_global: Numerous vintage cameras and lenses arranged neatly on a tiled floor, showcasing photographic equipment collection.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cameras organized in structured rows, with lenses and flashes scattered around for display or storage.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with bright, even lighting on a white tiled floor, suggesting a studio or display area.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dimly lit room with woman in bathroom, framed vintage car poster on wall.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Woman is inside bathroom, viewed through doorway from adjacent dark room.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm brown wood tones, patterned wallpaper, cool blue light from bathroom.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor domestic scene with low ambient lighting and wooden furniture.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Symmetrical perspective creates vanishing point, emphasizing depth and linear alignment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight glossy floor reflections and smooth wall surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cranes stand idle above containers, suggesting loading or unloading operations paused at night.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor industrial port at night, with distant city lights and calm water reflecting artificial illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vast yellow rapeseed field stretches under clear blue sky with distant trees and farmhouse.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Field slopes gently upward toward treeline, with farmhouse positioned at field's edge.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow petals contrast with deep green foliage and pale blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Sunlit rural countryside scene under clear weather with distant forested hills.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Arches line the wall in sequence, creating rhythmic pattern under artificial lights.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm yellow-orange glow contrasts with cool blue highlights and rough stone textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime scene with artificial lighting, ancient architecture, and dark sky.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Climbing wall has red and green holds, with white labels and textured surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person uses brush to apply chalk dust, while another person watches nearby.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Wall has rough, gray stone texture, with bright red and green climbing holds.

codebook_texts.C_global: An elderly woman with painted face and vibrant attire smiles warmly while clapping her hands.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: An elderly woman with gray hair, adorned with colorful beads and traditional jewelry, gazes upward with joy.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A bright red garment draped over her shoulders contrasts with a light blue underlayer visible at the neckline.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Her hands are clasped together in front of her chest, suggesting participation in a cultural or celebratory event.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich reds, deep blues, and earthy beads create a textured, layered visual with warm, glowing highlights.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: The scene is brightly lit, likely outdoors, with a dark, blurred background emphasizing the subject’s vivid presence.

codebook_texts.C_global: Cartoonish mushroom characters drive a tiny car, greeted by a green insect holding a clover.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large green insect with long legs holds a four-leaf clover near the car's front.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Mushroom drivers in a car interact with an insect offering a clover on a grassy path.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft pastel tones, textured paper background, and muted earthy greens and reds dominate the scene.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden setting with flowers, grass, and natural daylight illuminating the whimsical scene.

codebook_texts.C_global: A small squirrel sits amidst scattered orange seeds on earthy ground under soft sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The squirrel has brown fur, upright ears, and holds a seed in its paws while standing.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Numerous round orange seeds cover the ground around the squirrel's feet.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The squirrel is positioned centrally, surrounded by seeds, appearing to forage or eat.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm earth tones, soft fur texture, and glossy orange seeds contrast with blurred green background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor forest floor scene with shallow depth of field, natural daylight, and autumnal ambiance.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two camels stand in a vast desert landscape under a pale sky with distant dunes.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A large camel with a prominent hump stands facing forward, legs slightly apart.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A second camel grazes in the background, positioned further away and angled right.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The camels are spaced apart, one standing alert while the other is bent over foraging.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The camels have coarse, sandy-brown fur, and the ground is dry, dusty with scattered pebbles.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: An arid desert environment with rolling sand dunes, sparse vegetation, and bright daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted figure walks past hanging bench under grid-patterned roof in monochrome setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person in silhouette strides forward, head down, wearing jacket and pants.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Metal bench suspended by chains, showing worn surface and structural supports.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Walker moves leftward beside bench, positioned under overhead grid structure.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black and white tones, smooth surfaces, and chain-link textures dominate.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor covered area with artificial lighting, grid ceiling, and concrete ground.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted figures stretch arms upward against twilight sky with bare tree branches.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two human figures with raised arms form a heart shape against the dusk.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Bare tree branches create intricate patterns across the fading sky background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Figures appear to reach toward each other or sky, framed by tree silhouettes.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft gradient of orange, purple, and blue hues in the twilight sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor dusk scene with natural elements and atmospheric lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Spider weaves intricate web adorned with dewdrops against lush green foliage backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dew droplets cling to web threads, refracting light as spider remains motionless.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Transparent dewdrops shimmer against vibrant green background with subtle bokeh blur.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting with diffused daylight illuminating dew-laden spiderweb.

codebook_texts.C_global: Various travel and office supplies arranged neatly on a light wooden floor surface.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blue and yellow Falk Helsinki city map featuring landmarks and website URL.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Scissors, pen, ruler, tape, and glue stick are laid out for crafting or travel planning.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth black notebook cover, vibrant green stripe, and glossy plastic packaging.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with natural light illuminating a clean, light-colored wooden floor.

codebook_texts.C_global: Overhead view of vibrant blue pool surrounded by rocks, concrete, and leafy branches.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Branches with large green leaves hang over the pool's edge, casting natural shadows.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark gray stones and scattered brown leaves form a decorative border around the pool.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Leaves dangle above the water, while rocks line the pool’s edge in a naturalistic arrangement.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant turquoise water contrasts with dark gray stones and glossy green foliage.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor poolside setting under bright daylight with concrete pavement and natural landscaping.

codebook_texts.C_global: Abstract black and white architectural grid pattern with intersecting lines and reflective surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Vertical and horizontal black lines forming a geometric grid across the frame.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Reflective glass panels showing distorted reflections and faint diagonal shadows.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lines intersect at right angles, creating a structured, symmetrical composition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic grayscale tones with smooth, glossy surfaces and sharp linear edges.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor architectural setting with artificial lighting and clean, minimalist design.

codebook_texts.C_global: Fisheye lens captures vibrant orange subway train stopped at station platform with passengers visible inside.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Bright orange train car with reflective windows and sliding doors, showing interior passengers.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Train is stationary on curved tracks, passengers seated or standing inside, viewed from platform level.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange paint on train contrasts with gray concrete and black metal rails under artificial lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Underground subway station with arched ceiling beams, artificial lighting, and enclosed platform environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Autumn forest canopy viewed from below, vibrant leaves against clear blue sky.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Leaves cluster at tree tops, branches reach upward, creating natural canopy structure.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich orange, golden yellow, and deep brown tones with smooth leaf surfaces and rough bark textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor autumn woodland scene under clear daylight with natural sunlight filtering through leaves.

codebook_texts.C_global: A single white flower blooms against a stark black background, creating a dramatic contrast.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Yellow anthers on slender filaments extend from the flower's core.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: One door is open, revealing dark interior, while the other remains closed.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Red paint streaks contrast with gray stone and worn wood grain textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene under natural daylight with aged architectural elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Bluebell flowers bloom in lush green grass, creating a serene natural garden scene.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Delicate bluebell blossoms hang downward with bell-shaped petals and green stems.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Unopened flower buds cluster tightly, surrounded by long, pointed green leaves.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flowers grow upright in dense clusters, with some buds still closed and others fully bloomed.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft blue petals contrast with vibrant green leaves, showing smooth, glossy surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden setting with natural daylight, grassy ground, and no artificial structures.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Beige multi-story building with uniform windows and blue street sign visible in background.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rough brick texture, faded gray paint, bright orange spiky graffiti, and weathered surfaces dominate the scene.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban environment with diffused lighting, likely overcast, featuring street-level architecture and signage.

codebook_texts.C_global: Barbershop interior with two black chairs, mirrors, and tiled floor under arched ceiling lights.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two black barber chairs with red cushions, positioned facing mirrors and sinks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wooden cabinets, shelves with products, and a bicycle wheel visible near the foreground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Chairs arranged symmetrically for clients, with tools and mirrors for grooming services.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Cool-toned lighting highlights smooth tiles, dark leather chairs, and wooden cabinetry textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor barbershop with arched ceiling, fluorescent lighting, and tiled flooring.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person positioned centrally near equipment, with urban skyline stretching across horizon behind them.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Gray concrete, muted sky tones, and graffiti patterns create gritty, textured urban aesthetic.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rooftop playground under overcast sky with cityscape and industrial elements in background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person sits on toilet with legs crossed, surrounded by bathroom items under warm lighting.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person positioned on toilet, feet visible, with bathroom accessories arranged around.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm yellow tones, smooth ceramic, wooden grain, and soft towel fabric textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor bathroom with tiled walls and floor, lit by warm ambient light.

codebook_texts.C_global: American flag viewed through dark metal grid against textured wall surface.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with artificial lighting casting shadows on textured wall.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or nighttime festive setting with artificial lighting and dark backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Fire dancers perform mesmerizing light trails at night near waterfront with distant city lights.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Spectators seated on ground, metal railings, and distant illuminated buildings in background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Performers spin and twirl flaming objects, creating intricate light trails in open space.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden-orange flames contrast with dark pavement and cool night tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime performance near water, under artificial lighting with cityscape backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Wavy concrete buildings frame a dramatic sky with clouds and deep blue patches.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two symmetrical, undulating concrete structures with repeating horizontal balconies.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vibrant blue sky with white clouds visible between the buildings' curved forms.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Structures stand side by side, creating a V-shaped gap that frames the sky above.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth gray concrete surfaces contrast with bright blue sky and white cloud textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban architectural scene under partly cloudy daylight conditions.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden stone, glowing orange light, vibrant blue and red building illumination.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban night scene with architectural landmarks and festive lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A paraglider soars above a hazy valley with distant hills under overcast skies.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense green valley floor with scattered buildings and winding roads below.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person suspended beneath canopy, gliding over landscape with distant mountain range.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Muted earth tones, soft gray sky, vibrant red canopy against green terrain.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountainous landscape under cloudy, diffused lighting conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: A graceful mother swan leads her fluffy cygnets across a calm, algae-speckled pond under golden sunlight.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Three small, downy cygnets follow closely behind, their grayish feathers contrasting with the mother’s white plumage.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft white feathers, orange beak, dark eyes, and rippling water with green algae create a textured, natural palette.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor pond scene with dappled sunlight, reflective water surface, and natural vegetation in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: A gray bunny nestled in plaid fabric beside a vibrant pink gerbera daisy against a green backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large pink gerbera daisy with layered petals and a textured brown center.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant pink petals, soft gray fur, plaid fabric with blue and white stripes, and a shiny metallic button.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Brightly lit studio setting with a solid green background and shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Minimalist workspace with vintage cameras, wooden drawers, and modern desk under soft ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm wood grain, smooth white surfaces, metallic chrome legs, and muted gray wall with soft lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor home office or studio with hardwood flooring, neutral tones, and natural daylight ambiance.

codebook_texts.C_global: A smiling young man wearing a scarf sits in a dimly lit indoor space with another person nearby.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A partially visible person in the background wearing a plaid shirt and dark jacket.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft pink scarf with fringe, dark clothing, and cool blue ambient lighting with warm highlights.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant yellow bird perches calmly on tree branch amid lush green foliage.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vivid yellow plumage contrasts with mossy gray bark and glossy green leaves.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Behind her, a gentle hill slopes upward with scattered trees and a bright sun low on the horizon.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She is positioned in the foreground, looking toward the viewer, while the landscape stretches behind her.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The scene features soft greens, warm yellows, and muted skin tones with a textured grassy foreground.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural setting at golden hour, with clear skies and natural ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunlit dirt road winds through vibrant sunflower field under dramatic cloud-filled sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Winding dirt road stretches into distance, flanked by tall sunflowers and golden wheat.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense cluster of yellow sunflowers with green stems and leaves on left side of path.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Road curves gently rightward, separating sunflower patch from distant wheat field.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow sunflowers contrast with golden wheat, blue sky, and white fluffy clouds.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural landscape under bright daylight with scattered cumulus clouds overhead.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Another woman with dark hair leans close, both sharing a muddy, festive moment.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Muddy splatters contrast with smooth skin and glossy sunglasses in monochrome tones.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Striped shirt worn by the second person, partially obscured by motion blur.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Two individuals are kissing closely, surrounded by dynamic laser beams and shadows.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall lampposts line the bridge, their classic design contrasting with the snowy, muted surroundings.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban landscape at twilight, with dramatic atmospheric lighting and scattered clouds.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vintage television displays cartoon character on wooden stand in warmly lit room.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Rounded television screen shows animated girl with bow in hair.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wooden table supports TV, with chair and person partially visible nearby.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cartoon character appears on screen while person watches from right side.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm beige walls, dark wood grain, and glossy black TV casing with metallic trim.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft ambient lighting and vintage furniture arrangement.

codebook_texts.C_global: Railway tracks stretch straight ahead between two platforms under a covered station structure.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two parallel steel rails embedded in wooden sleepers and gravel ballast form the central focus.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Yellow safety lines mark the edges of concrete platforms flanking the tracks on both sides.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Tracks converge toward the vanishing point, creating a symmetrical perspective from above.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Metallic gray rails contrast with weathered brown sleepers and gritty gray gravel beneath.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or covered transit station with artificial lighting and structured architectural elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: String of festive red and green lights hangs against a blurred urban backdrop, glowing warmly in soft focus.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A single red bulb with green cap dangles from wire, sharply focused against blurred surroundings.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Out-of-focus blue light and distant green bulbs appear in background, creating depth and festive contrast.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bulbs are strung in linear sequence, suspended horizontally, suggesting decorative holiday display.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red glass bulb with glossy finish, green plastic cap, and soft bokeh from ambient lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime scene with artificial lighting, likely urban or residential, under overcast or diffused sky.

codebook_texts.C_global: A weathered boat rests in calm waters under a stormy sky with distant smoke rising.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: White motorboat with multiple windows, railings, and a small cabin structure.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark smoke plume rising from distant land, palm trees lining the shoreline.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Boat is anchored near shore, smoke drifts across the horizon, water reflects the gloom.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic blue-gray tones, smooth water surface, weathered hull texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Overcast coastal scene with dramatic clouds, calm water, and distant landmass.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dramatic sunset paints sky and water with fiery hues, silhouetting distant trees along calm riverbank.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Vast sky filled with textured clouds glowing in warm orange and yellow tones during twilight.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark silhouetted treeline and distant hills bordering the reflective water surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Clouds reflect across still water, mirroring the vibrant sky above the horizon line.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich gradients of orange, yellow, and deep purple with soft cloud textures and shimmering water reflections.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor river landscape at sunset with clear weather, calm water, and natural horizon lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman stands smiling in front of vibrant floral-patterned wall with red and white stripes below.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Curly-haired woman wearing black shirt, jeans, and white sneakers with hand near face.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Gray backpack slung over shoulder, contrasting with colorful background behind her.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She poses playfully against the patterned wall, standing on striped floor with relaxed stance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Bold red, white, and black swirling floral pattern with glossy surface and vivid contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor photo studio or art installation with artificial lighting and decorative backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Red-walled room features exercise equipment with hats, casting striped shadows from blinds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Ergometer with digital display, black handles, and metallic frame stands upright.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red knit cap and woven straw hat rest atop the ergometer’s console and handlebars.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Hats are placed on equipment, suggesting playful or staged use in a fitness setting.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep red walls, metallic sheen on equipment, and warm ambient lighting create bold contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor fitness studio with artificial lighting and window blinds casting horizontal shadows.

codebook_texts.C_global: Red rock formations rise dramatically against a clear blue sky in a vast desert landscape.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Towering red sandstone spires stand vertically, sculpted by erosion into unique shapes.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Sparse green shrubs dot the foreground, contrasting with the arid red earth.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The spires are positioned behind a sloping red hillside, creating layered depth in the scene.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant reds and oranges dominate the rocks, while muted greens and browns appear in the vegetation.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor desert environment under bright daylight with minimal cloud cover and wide open space.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant purple cosmos flowers bloom in a dark, softly blurred garden under dramatic lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Prominent purple cosmos flowers with yellow centers and delicate petals stand tall on slender stems.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background contains out-of-focus purple blooms and green foliage, creating depth and bokeh effect.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flowers are arranged in clusters, some upright and others drooping, with stems curving gracefully.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich magenta petals contrast with bright yellow stamens and dark, velvety background tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime or twilight garden scene with high-contrast lighting and shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vintage European restaurant with wooden facade and outdoor seating on cobblestone street.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Restaurant named 'Restaurant Astier' with large glass windows and wooden trim.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White metal chairs and small round tables arranged outside the establishment.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Outdoor seating area positioned directly in front of the restaurant entrance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm brown wood, white metal chairs, and dark cobblestone pavement under soft lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban street scene during daytime with historic architecture and clear weather.

codebook_texts.C_global: Winding road stretches through lush valley with towering green mountains under cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Asphalt road curves gently forward, marked by double yellow lines and white edge lines.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Metal guardrail runs along right side, bordered by dense green shrubbery and grass.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Road leads toward distant mountains, with valley floor visible between foreground and background.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich green vegetation contrasts with gray asphalt and white clouds above rugged mountain ridges.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountainous landscape under partly cloudy skies, suggesting daytime travel through scenic terrain.

codebook_texts.C_global: A runner pauses near a tree beside a stone bridge under warm evening light.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman in athletic wear stands with hands clasped, wearing a headband and sneakers.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large tree with thick trunk and sprawling branches dominates the right side of the frame.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The runner is positioned beside the bridge, facing slightly away from the camera.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm sepia tones highlight rough bark, smooth concrete, and grassy ground textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor park setting with soft golden hour lighting and distant foliage in background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunset paints calm waters as people enjoy quiet moments near rocky shoreline and distant pier.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Silhouetted figures in small boat drift peacefully across tranquil water surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rugged rocks line foreground, while wooden pier extends into horizon with lighthouse at end.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People stand on pier edge, boat floats nearby, and water gently laps against rocky shore.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft pastel hues blend across sky, reflecting on smooth water, contrasted by dark textured rocks.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Coastal waterscape at dusk, featuring calm sea, rocky terrain, and fading golden sunlight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Hello Kitty mascot in vibrant costume stands beside two people at an indoor event.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large Hello Kitty mascot wearing pink bow and colorful outfit with yellow gloves.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Two individuals behind mascot, one in chef hat, other in dark jacket with pins.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Mascot holds yellow prop while standing still, people beside it appear to be posing.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Bright pink, yellow, and gold fabrics with glittery accents and soft plush textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with plain beige wall background and even artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A spotted horse stands inside a wooden stable with hay-covered ground and slatted walls.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The horse has a distinctive black-and-white spotted coat and is standing sideways with head lowered.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vertical wooden posts and horizontal slats form the enclosure walls around the horse.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The horse is positioned near a wooden gate, appearing to be in a confined indoor space.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The horse's coat features contrasting black spots on white fur, with dark mane and tail.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor stable environment with natural light filtering through slatted walls and metal roof.

codebook_texts.C_global: A lone tire rests on a winding dirt road through a rugged, hilly, and sparsely vegetated landscape.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A worn, black rubber tire lies abandoned, centered on the gravel path.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Sparse bushes, scattered rocks, and distant trees populate the uneven terrain surrounding the road.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The tire is stationary, positioned mid-road, suggesting abandonment or a forgotten journey.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight rough gravel, soft grass, and the matte, weathered surface of the tire.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural setting under natural daylight, with rolling hills and dry vegetation in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime architectural marvel reflects in calm water, surrounded by city lights and tall trees.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Modern curved building with glass panels and white structural beams glows under artificial lighting.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall, slender trees line the waterfront, their silhouettes mirrored in the still water surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Building stands prominently beside water, with reflections creating symmetrical visual balance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth reflective water, warm yellow artificial lights, and cool white structural illumination contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban waterfront at night, under dark sky, with artificial lighting illuminating architectural structures.

codebook_texts.C_global: Illustrated card depicts cartoon characters in whimsical office setting with surreal elements.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Cartoon figures with hats and wings appear as paper cutouts arranged on a pink surface.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows blurred water bottles and a smiling person in a photo frame.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Characters are positioned as if interacting with each other and office equipment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Pink and yellow hues dominate with matte textures and soft lighting effects.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor office environment with artificial lighting and scattered papers on a wooden desk.

codebook_texts.C_global: Autumn landscape with lone tree, fallen leaves, and distant mountains under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Single slender tree with orange leaves stands tall against the horizon.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Scattered red and brown leaves cover the grassy foreground in shallow focus.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Leaves rest on ground while tree rises above, mountains frame the background.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange, red, and brown hues contrast with cool blue sky and dry grass texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor autumnal scene with bright sunlight, clear weather, and mountainous backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black sports car showcased on reflective grid floor against dark studio background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Streamlined black Lotus sports car with pop-up headlights and rear spoiler.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Silver alloy wheels with central emblems and red taillights on rear bumper.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Car positioned at three-quarter rear angle, highlighting aerodynamic design.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Glossy black paint, metallic silver accents, and polished chrome trim details.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Controlled studio lighting with black backdrop and reflective textured flooring.

codebook_texts.C_global: Aerial view of ancient stone castle ruins surrounded by green fields and parked cars.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Weathered stone castle with multiple towers and collapsed walls on a grassy mound.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rows of parked cars along a winding road near the castle perimeter.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Castle ruins stand isolated on elevated ground, viewed from above with surrounding trees and fields.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Lush green grass contrasts with gray stone walls and white parked cars under bright daylight.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural landscape with clear skies, open fields, and forested areas surrounding the historic site.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two soldiers in camouflage gear stand alert near building entrance with rifles drawn.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Soldier wearing helmet and tactical vest holds rifle with both hands, aiming forward.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Second soldier beside him also holds rifle, wearing helmet and tactical gear.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Both soldiers are positioned side by side, facing same direction near doorway.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Camouflage patterned uniforms, tan tactical gear, and dark rifle with metallic accents.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with building wall, wooden staircase, and natural daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Blue tiled wall with two air conditioning units mounted near grassy ground.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two large white air conditioning units with circular fans and metal grilles.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Small gray electrical box mounted on wall above the units.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Units are positioned side by side against wall, connected by pipes and wires.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue tiles with white grout lines, green grass with scattered brown patches.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor commercial or industrial building exterior under bright daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted woman gazes upward in dramatic black-and-white portrait against pure dark background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman with long flowing hair, head tilted back, face illuminated by side lighting.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark void background emphasizes subject's form and creates high contrast silhouette effect.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Subject appears contemplative or reverent, positioned diagonally with arms extended forward.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic tones with smooth skin texture, soft hair strands, and stark shadow gradients.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio-style portrait with controlled lighting, isolated subject, and minimalist black backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up black-and-white portrait captures intense human eye expression and facial details.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Human eye with detailed iris, eyebrow, and surrounding skin texture in monochrome.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Stray hair strands frame the eye, adding softness to the sharp facial features.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Camera focuses tightly on eye, emphasizing gaze direction and emotional intensity.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight skin pores, fine lines, and reflective eye surface textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio-style lighting creates high contrast, isolating subject against neutral background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime cityscape reflects warmly lit buildings across calm water under deep blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Modern multi-story residential buildings line waterfront with glowing windows and balconies.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant spire and reeds along water's edge add depth and natural contrast to urban scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lights from buildings mirror perfectly in still water, creating symmetrical visual balance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich navy blue sky contrasts with warm amber and white artificial lights reflecting on smooth water.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban waterfront at twilight with clear weather, calm water, and artificial lighting dominating scene.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow-covered trees adorned with glowing string lights illuminate a quiet urban street at dusk.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall, bare-branched trees decorated with warm, twinkling lights stand prominently in the foreground.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Snow-laden rooftops and parked cars line the background behind the illuminated trees.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lights wrap around tree branches, casting a soft glow over the snowy ground and surrounding buildings.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden lights contrast with white snow and dark tree trunks, creating a cozy, textured glow.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Winter evening in a city park or residential area, with overcast skies and artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two workers atop a tall, weathered water tower against a pale sky with industrial buildings behind.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A large, cylindrical metal water tower with a rusted platform and supporting truss structure.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Industrial buildings with windows and rooftop equipment visible in the background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Workers stand on the tower's platform, appearing to inspect or maintain the structure.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark, weathered metal surfaces contrast with the pale, overcast sky and concrete buildings.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban industrial scene under diffused, overcast lighting conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: White plate holds vibrant red and orange flowers against a backdrop of stylized black-and-white human figures.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A white ceramic plate with floral illustrations and text, filled with colorful gerbera daisies.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black line drawings of simplified human figures in the background, appearing as a crowd or mural.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flowers rest in the plate, positioned in front of the illustrated figures, suggesting a decorative display.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red and orange petals contrast with the white plate and black outlines of the background figures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with bright, even lighting, featuring a clean, minimalist aesthetic with graphic art elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of white flowers with long stamens against blurred green foliage background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: White petals radiate outward from center, forming star-like bloom structure.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Yellow-tipped stamens extend beyond petals, contrasting with green backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flowers positioned side by side, with one slightly overlapping the other.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth white petals, vibrant yellow stamen tips, and soft green background blur.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene with natural daylight and shallow depth of field.

codebook_texts.C_global: Three plush seahorse toys arranged on a plain white surface, showcasing a family-like grouping.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large textured seahorse with blue eye, curled tail, and patterned fin, appearing as a parent figure.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Smaller seahorse plush toy positioned beside the larger one, suggesting a child or companion.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Seahorses are positioned in a nurturing arrangement, implying familial connection or care.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft beige plush material with vibrant blue eye and multicolored patterned fin on the larger seahorse.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Minimalist indoor setting with bright, even lighting and plain white background for clear visibility.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person with braided hair stands in crowd outdoors near buildings and trees.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Back view of person with long, thick, intricately braided hair and green earring.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Orange jacket worn by person in background and black backpack straps visible.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Individuals gathered closely, suggesting public event or street gathering.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Brown braids, green earring, gray shirt, and textured black backpack straps.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with trees, buildings, and daylight illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Wall covered with numerous small photos, wooden table, and ladder in dimly lit room.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Wall displays dense grid of varied photographs, each depicting different scenes and subjects.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wooden ladder leans against wall, positioned near table with scattered papers and tools.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Photos arranged in organized grid pattern, suggesting creative selection or design process.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Photos show vibrant colors and diverse textures, while walls are neutral gray and table is dark wood.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor workspace with focused lighting, surrounded by photo-covered walls and creative tools.

codebook_texts.C_global: A dimly lit alleyway with a hanging lamp, bags, and a rusted gate with Chinese writing.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A yellow dome-shaped lamp hanging from the ceiling, casting warm light downward.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A folded white towel inside an orange plastic bag, hanging beside the lamp.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The lamp illuminates the wall and gate, with bags suspended nearby in a cluttered space.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Worn greenish wall with rust stains, dark reddish-brown metal gate, and faded yellow light.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban alleyway at night, featuring industrial textures, graffiti, and ambient artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Woman lies on grass surrounded by petals and daisies, holding magnifying glass near face.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Young woman with dark hair, wearing patterned top, lying on her back on grass.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White daisies and pink petals scattered across green grass around her.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She holds magnifying glass close to face, examining something unseen in the lens.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green grass, soft white daisies, pink petals, and floral patterned fabric.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting under bright daylight, grassy field with scattered flowers.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vintage white dresser holds floral arrangement, suitcases, and decorative items outdoors.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: White ornate dresser with curved legs and brass handles stands prominently.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Pastel tulips in mint vase sit atop dresser beside patterned teacup.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Suitcases stacked vertically on dresser, flowers arranged beside them.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft white paint, brass hardware, woven wicker, and glossy ceramic surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor patio with brick pavers and lush green foliage under bright daylight.

codebook_texts.C_global: Healthy meal prep featuring wraps, carrots, pickles, and dip in a white container.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Green-wrapped sandwiches rolled tightly with visible cucumber and tomato slices inside.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Small bowl of baby carrots and another with creamy white dip beside the main container.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Food items arranged neatly in separate bowls, suggesting a ready-to-eat lunch or snack set.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange carrots, creamy white dip, and green wrap with crisp vegetable textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Brightly lit indoor setting with white surfaces and an orange napkin visible in the corner.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snow blankets rolling hills and forests under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A gnarled tree with twisted branches frames the foreground, overlooking the valley below.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant ridges and patches of snow-covered ground create depth in the expansive landscape.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The viewer's perspective is elevated, looking down through tree branches onto the valley floor.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White snow contrasts with dark evergreen trees and the blue sky dotted with fluffy clouds.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter scene with clear weather, open terrain, and natural daylight illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Rusted metal door with peeling paint and bolts shows decayed industrial machinery.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Weathered metal door with bolts, hinges, and faded paint layers.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Yellowish-orange rust patches contrast with greenish patina on metal surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bolts and hinges suggest structural fastening, indicating past mechanical use.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich rust tones, teal-green patina, and rough corroded textures dominate the surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or sheltered industrial setting with dim, warm lighting highlighting decay.

codebook_texts.C_global: Urban wall covered in layered graffiti, posters, and torn paper art with bold visual elements.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Central poster features stylized eye with colorful rays and red lips, framed by torn edges.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Above the main poster, a fragmented portrait of a man's face with blue eyes and dark hair.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Torn posters and layered materials suggest urban decay and artistic collage on a weathered wall.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant reds, blacks, and multicolored stripes contrast with rough, textured concrete and torn paper surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or sheltered urban alleyway wall with dim lighting and visible wooden door frame on the right.

codebook_texts.C_global: Fog blankets a quiet field with bare trees standing still in muted gray tones.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Three leafless trees with intricate branch patterns rise from the foggy ground.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant, blurred shapes suggest additional trees or shrubs hidden in the mist.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Trees are spaced apart, creating a linear arrangement across the open field.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft gray and white tones dominate, with smooth, damp grass textures visible.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor landscape under heavy fog, with diffused lighting and low visibility.

codebook_texts.C_global: White ghost-like figures peek through lush green foliage under bright sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A white, rounded, head-shaped object with orange eyes partially hidden by leaves.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Two additional similar white objects blurred in the background among greenery.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Objects are nestled among leaves, suggesting concealment or playful placement.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth white surfaces contrast with vibrant green leaves and bright orange eye details.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene with dappled sunlight filtering through dense foliage.

codebook_texts.C_global: Serene alpine lake mirrors snow-capped mountains under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Still water reflects distant peaks and sky with visible submerged rocks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rugged rocky shoreline borders the lake, with sparse vegetation along its edge.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Water surface remains calm, creating mirror-like reflection of surrounding landscape.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blue water transitions to greenish hues over smooth, moss-covered stones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor alpine environment with bright daylight, clear weather, and mountainous backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant neon tubes arranged diagonally create a dazzling, colorful abstract composition under bright lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Long cylindrical tubes with colored bands stand upright, glowing intensely in a tight, angled formation.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows dark shadows and faint reflections, enhancing contrast with the glowing tubes.
