codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Rusted vintage truck with broken windows and missing parts, partially buried in tall weeds.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dismantled metal trailer lies tilted behind truck, covered in rust and vegetation.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Truck and trailer abandoned together, overgrown vegetation encroaching on both structures.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rust-red metal, faded yellow paint, green foliage, and dry beige grass create textured contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural scene under bright daylight, with trees, open field, and natural overgrowth.

codebook_texts.C_global: Ants swarm over a bright pink, textured object on a rough concrete surface.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Cluster of dark ants with segmented bodies and antennae crawling on a pink item.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Concrete ground with scattered pebbles and faint cracks surrounding the pink object.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Ants actively gather and move around the pink object, some climbing its surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant pink with white speckles contrasts against the gray, gritty concrete texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene under natural daylight on a weathered concrete pavement surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two people stand atop a massive pile of concrete tetrapods under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large, gray, cylindrical concrete blocks arranged in a jagged, protective barrier formation.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A shirtless man and a person in blue shirt peeking from behind the concrete structures.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Individuals are positioned at different heights on the structure, suggesting exploration or rest.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, weathered gray concrete surfaces contrast with the pale blue sky and human skin tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal environment under bright daylight with minimal clouds and open horizon.

codebook_texts.C_global: A large green moth with eye spots rests on a textured white wall, wings fully spread.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The moth has elongated green wings with dark borders and two prominent circular markings.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The rough, uneven white wall surface shows subtle texture and minor imperfections.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The moth is stationary, positioned centrally with wings open, facing slightly upward.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft green hues with white and dark brown accents, smooth wing surfaces contrast rough wall texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with neutral lighting, plain textured wall background, no visible weather or outdoor elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dramatic sky illuminates a silhouetted sign against twilight cloudscape.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Vertical sign with bold lettering reads 'SOUTH AS BOW' in dark outline.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall poles support the sign, with street lamp visible on right side.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Sign stands upright, angled slightly, viewed from low perspective beneath clouds.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange-yellow clouds contrast with deep blue and black sky tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene at dusk with moody, cloud-filled atmospheric lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted fisherman in boat drifts through misty lake surrounded by dark pine trees at dawn.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person seated in small rowboat holding oars, partially obscured by fog and backlighting.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall coniferous trees stand in silhouette against dark sky, framing mist-covered water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Fisherman floats alone on calm water, mist rising from surface, creating serene isolation.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black and white tones emphasize misty textures, smooth water, and sharp tree outlines.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor lakeside scene at early morning, enveloped in dense fog with dim ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two pedestrians walk across wet pavement under gray skies in urban setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Man in dark coat and hat strides forward, raincoat trailing behind him.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White cylindrical posts stand on sidewalk near curb in background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Individuals move diagonally across reflective tiled surface toward camera.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight glossy wet tiles and textured raincoat fabric.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban street scene during rainy weather with overcast lighting and wet surfaces.

codebook_texts.C_global: A vibrant yellow flower cluster hosts a dark beetle in a sunlit meadow setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A glossy black beetle perches atop a dense yellow flower head, legs gripping tightly.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurry green stems and out-of-focus yellow blooms form the background depth.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The beetle is stationary on the flower, positioned centrally with natural depth of field.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow petals with fine textured florets contrast against the beetle's smooth dark shell.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural scene under bright daylight, with soft bokeh and green foliage backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: A geisha walks down a traditional Japanese street lined with wooden buildings and lanterns.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A geisha in pink and floral kimono, holding a fan, wearing geta sandals.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Bicycles parked beside potted plants and a red lantern hanging from a wooden eave.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Geisha strides forward on stone pavement, passing by storefronts and street-side greenery.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft pink fabric with floral patterns, wooden textures, and glossy black bicycle tires.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban street in Japan, under daylight, with traditional architecture and signage.

codebook_texts.C_global: Weathered yellow door with rusty knob and peeling paint under bright sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Round white doorknob with chipped surface, mounted on a wooden door.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark shadow cast by the knob onto the yellow-painted wood surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Doorknob is affixed to door with visible screw and rusted metal base.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant yellow paint with rough texture, contrasted by white knob and rusted metal.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene with direct sunlight, showing weathered wooden door and glass window.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vast open field under bright blue sky with scattered clouds and distant tree-lined hills.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Wide expanse of tilled earth with scattered green grass patches and gentle rolling terrain.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense green forested hills in the background, framing the horizon with lush foliage.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Field stretches forward toward tree-covered hills, with clouds drifting above the landscape.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich orange-brown soil texture contrasts with vibrant green vegetation and deep blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor rural landscape under clear daylight with partly cloudy weather and natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vintage album cover features a choir in white dresses posing before large windows with a portrait overlay.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A group of singers dressed uniformly in white gowns arranged in rows for a formal photograph.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large portrait of a man with glasses is superimposed in the upper left corner of the image.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Choir members stand in organized rows, facing forward, suggesting a staged performance or recording session.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft pastel tones with subtle dot patterns on dresses, contrasted by muted window grilles and red text accents.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor studio setting with expansive glass windows, artificial lighting, and vintage album design elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Weathered stone spiral pattern embedded in pebble mosaic pavement under natural light.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Circular concrete spiral with cracked surface, surrounded by dark rounded stones.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark, smooth, wet-looking volcanic pebbles arranged in concentric rings around the spiral.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Spiral design embedded within stone pavement, suggesting intentional artistic or symbolic placement.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Contrasting textures: rough cracked concrete, smooth dark pebbles, and earthy grime accents.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor ground surface, likely a walkway or courtyard, under diffused daylight with damp patches.

codebook_texts.C_global: A blurred black-and-white portrait of a person gently touching their face with a contemplative expression.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A person with long dark hair, eyes closed, hand near their face, wearing a ring.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A metallic ring on the person's finger and soft out-of-focus background elements.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The person's hand is positioned near their eye, suggesting introspection or emotional moment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic tones with smooth skin texture and soft shadows creating depth.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with dim lighting, blurred background, and intimate close-up composition.

codebook_texts.C_global: People interact with glowing vertical light panels in a dimly lit modern art installation.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A person in silhouette holds a camera, capturing the illuminated wall with vertical stripes.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A man reaches toward the glowing panels, while another person stands nearby in shadow.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Visitors engage with interactive light panels, extending arms and taking photos in a dark room.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue and white vertical stripes contrast with deep shadows and smooth, glowing surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor contemporary art exhibit with controlled lighting, featuring interactive illuminated walls.

codebook_texts.C_global: A Ben & Jerry's ice cream tub with Stephen Colbert's Americone Dream flavor, featuring patriotic red, white, and blue design.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A cylindrical ice cream container with a black lid, labeled 'Stephen Colbert's Americone Dream'.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A portrait of Stephen Colbert on the label, holding a scoop of ice cream with a star above his head.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The ice cream tub is positioned upright on a plain white surface, viewed from a slightly elevated angle.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The label has bold red, white, and blue stripes with glossy, printed text and a textured plastic lid.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: An indoor setting with bright, even lighting and a clean, neutral white background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Golden-hued fog blankets calm waters near a lit shoreline with distant trees and glowing lights.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Smooth, dark rocks line the foreground along the water's edge under warm ambient light.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Faintly visible trees stand along the misty shore, illuminated by scattered artificial lights.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Water reflects distant lights while mist drifts over the surface, creating a serene atmosphere.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm amber tones dominate, with smooth water textures and soft, hazy atmospheric gradients.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal scene at twilight or night, enveloped in fog with artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man with thick beard stares directly at camera in softly lit indoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Bearded man with reddish hair and freckles gazes intensely forward.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Plain textured wall behind subject provides neutral backdrop for portrait.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Subject's head slightly tilted while maintaining direct eye contact with viewer.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm sepia tones highlight coarse beard texture and soft fabric of shirt.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor portrait shot with even lighting against a plain, textured wall background.

codebook_texts.C_global: A man in a suit and bowler hat leaps mid-air in a dimly lit industrial space with dramatic lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A man wearing a bowler hat, suit, and tie, arms outstretched, suspended in mid-air.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Metal truss structure in the background and a long shadow cast on the ground.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The man is jumping on a trampoline, creating a dynamic pose with arms spread wide.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black and white tones with grainy texture and stark shadows.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor industrial setting with artificial spotlighting and dusty, uneven floor surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime city skyline reflects in calm water, creating mirrored lights and urban glow.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall skyscrapers with glowing windows and blue-tinted tops dominate the skyline.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Trees line the waterfront, their silhouettes visible against the illuminated buildings.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Buildings stand along the riverbank, their lights mirrored in the still water below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue and warm yellow lights contrast with dark sky and reflective water surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban waterfront at night under cloudy sky, with artificial lighting and calm water.

codebook_texts.C_global: A shirtless man stares directly at the camera in a dimly lit, monochrome portrait setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A balding man with a serious expression, bare-chested, and looking straight ahead.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A plain, textured wall behind him, casting a soft shadow on the left side.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The man is positioned centrally, facing forward, with minimal environmental interaction.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black-and-white tones with visible grain, emphasizing skin and hair textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor, low-key lighting, neutral background, suggesting a personal or studio portrait environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Warm orange pendant lights hang in a modern interior with bold red and yellow walls.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Cylindrical orange pendant lamps with white inner diffusers hang vertically from ceiling.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Large windows with white frames line the wall, reflecting ambient light and interior.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Lamps are suspended in a staggered row, creating a rhythmic visual pattern along the wall.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red, orange, and yellow hues dominate, with smooth painted walls and glass panes.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor contemporary space with artificial lighting, likely a restaurant or lounge area.

codebook_texts.C_global: Stacked children's educational books with colorful spines and varied illustrations arranged vertically against a brick wall.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A vertical stack of children's books with titles like 'The Bug Book' and 'How Things Work' visible on spines.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Brick wall background with visible mortar lines behind the stacked books.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Books are neatly stacked in descending order, showing spine numbers from 1 to 15.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant, varied spine colors including green, red, blue, and orange with glossy printed illustrations.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or sheltered setting with artificial lighting casting soft shadows on the books and wall.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of a young deer with small antlers standing in a grassy field.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Deer has soft brown fur, alert ears, and developing antlers with velvet texture.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows blurred green grass with scattered light patches and distant rocks.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Deer is facing left, head slightly turned, suggesting calm observation or movement.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Fur appears coarse and earthy brown, antlers covered in fuzzy gray velvet, eyes dark and glossy.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting under bright daylight with soft shadows and open grassy terrain.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two laughing children sit on a colorful bench in a busy public transport station.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two young girls wearing striped shirts and pink pants sit side by side.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large black plaid bag rests between them on the bench.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Children are seated next to each other, smiling and holding toys while adults stand nearby.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant multicolored bench with yellow, red, green, and orange sections.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor public space with tiled floors, large windows, and people waiting in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Pink poppies bloom in front of a grand stone temple under bright blue skies.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tall pink poppies with dark centers and green stems stand prominently in the foreground.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large, ornate stone temple with spires and arched windows forms the background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Poppies grow in a garden bed, positioned low to the ground with the temple towering behind.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant pink petals contrast with deep green stems and the clear azure sky above.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene on a sunny day with clear skies and architectural backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vast turquoise ocean meets sandy beach under clear blue sky with distant buildings.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Curved shoreline with gentle waves lapping at golden sand and sparse vegetation.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Low concrete barrier along foreground with dry shrubs and rocky terrain.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Beachgoers scattered along shore, ocean waves rolling in, distant structures visible.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant turquoise water, pale sandy beach, muted earthy tones of dry shrubs and rocks.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Sunny coastal scene with clear skies, arid landscape, and urban development in background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant yellow star-shaped flowers bloom densely beside a fleshy green succulent with red-tipped leaves.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Cluster of bright yellow, star-like flowers with thin petals and central stamens.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Succulent plant with thick, overlapping leaves edged in red and green hues.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flowers grow in dense clusters atop stems, positioned beside the succulent's rosette structure.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vivid yellow petals contrast with glossy green leaves tipped in deep red, under bright sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene with natural sunlight, blurred greenery background, and warm lighting tones.

codebook_texts.C_global: Fallen leaves blanket the ground, with vibrant green and brown hues creating a seasonal tapestry.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Green maple leaves with yellow spots lie scattered among dried brown foliage.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Small brown twigs and moss patches peek through the leaf litter on the forest floor.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Leaves are arranged randomly, overlapping each other across the ground surface.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich earthy browns contrast with bright green leaves showing yellow mottling and rough textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor forest floor under diffuse natural light, suggesting a cool autumn day.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dancer leaps gracefully on beach under stormy sky with red scarf billowing.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person in black outfit balances on one leg, arms raised holding flowing red fabric.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant mountains with snow caps and dark cloudy sky form scenic backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Dancer performs dynamic pose, scarf caught in wind, body angled mid-motion.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red fabric contrasts with muted grays, blacks, and sandy tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor beach scene under overcast, dramatic weather with natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A large pale wall with a white diagonal stripe and a brown dumpster beside it.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A brown metal dumpster with wheels and a lid, positioned against a wall.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A wide white painted stripe diagonally cutting across the concrete wall surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The dumpster rests at the base of the wall, aligned near its lower right corner.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Pale greenish wall with rough texture, white stripe, and brown dumpster with metallic sheen.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting with flat ground, under diffuse daylight, likely industrial or commercial area.

codebook_texts.C_global: A vibrant graffiti-covered wall with Dutch text and colorful abstract designs on a city sidewalk.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: White handwritten Dutch text on a magenta-painted wall, partially obscured by a spray-painted patch.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black graffiti outlines and a partial orange and blue geometric design in the upper right corner.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Text is spray-painted directly onto the wall, positioned above a concrete sidewalk with small green weeds.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vivid magenta background with white lettering, black outlines, and subtle purple speckles on the wall surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene with a paved sidewalk, under natural daylight, showing signs of graffiti art and wear.

codebook_texts.C_global: A majestic lion rests peacefully with its mouth open, basking in warm sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The lion's thick mane frames its face, showing powerful facial features and whiskers.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Its sharp canine teeth and pink tongue are visible inside the open mouth.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The lion appears to be yawning or relaxing, lying down with head slightly tilted.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Golden-brown fur with soft, sunlit textures contrasts with pale pink gums and black lips.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor setting under bright daylight, with natural lighting highlighting the lion's features.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted figure walks alone on wet beach under dramatic cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person stands in silhouette, facing ocean, wearing coat and hat.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wavy ocean meets shoreline, with small ripples and wet sand texture.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Individual walks toward water's edge, casting long shadow on damp ground.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones, smooth wet sand, textured clouds, and dark silhouette contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal scene under overcast sky, with horizon line dividing sea and sky.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two children smile closely together, one holding a pacifier in black and white.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Child on left has dark skin, wears striped shirt, and holds pacifier near mouth.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Child on right has lighter skin, bright eyes, and visible teeth in a wide grin.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Children are positioned side by side, faces close, sharing a joyful moment.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones, smooth skin textures, striped fabric pattern, and glossy pacifier surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft lighting, intimate close-up shot, no discernible background elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Three women with painted bellies smile together against a black background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Three women, two younger and one older, pose closely with arms around each other.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red painted text on their exposed bellies reads '194 NON TOCCARIA'.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: They stand in a triangular formation, embracing and looking at each other joyfully.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Skin tones contrast with dark clothing and bold red paint on their stomachs.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio setting with black backdrop, bright direct lighting, and no environmental distractions.

codebook_texts.C_global: A single, floating soap bubble reflects a blurred outdoor scene with vibrant colors and soft lighting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A spherical, translucent bubble with iridescent hues and visible surface distortions.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A softly blurred background with indistinct shapes and gradient color transitions.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The bubble hovers suspended in air, capturing and distorting its surroundings through refraction.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant rainbow-like reflections, smooth glossy surface, and subtle speckled patterns on the bubble.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or controlled environment with diffused lighting and out-of-focus background elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: A man rests against a weathered wall, hand near his eye in a contemplative black-and-white portrait.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A young man with a shaved head, wearing a tattered shirt, gazes thoughtfully at the camera.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A worn wooden wall with visible scratches and a small dark mark near the top right corner.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The man's hand is raised to his eye, suggesting introspection or fatigue against a plain backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight rough textures on the wall and fabric, emphasizing grain and wear.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or shaded setting with soft, directional lighting casting gentle shadows on the subject and wall.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black and white photo captures diverse pedestrians crossing wide striped street in urban setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: People with bags and briefcases walk across zebra crossing in various directions.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Wide diagonal stripes on pavement create strong visual pattern across entire scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Crowd moves in different directions, some carrying luggage, others walking alone.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast monochrome tones emphasize textures of pavement and clothing fabrics.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban outdoor environment under bright daylight with clear shadows and crisp lines.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime cityscape with illuminated skyscrapers and a bridge over a reflective river.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A dark metal truss bridge spans the river, silhouetted against city lights.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall buildings with glowing windows and a distinctive domed tower dominate the skyline.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bridge connects riverbanks while city lights reflect on water below, creating symmetry.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden and white lights contrast with dark silhouettes and reflective water surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban nighttime scene with artificial lighting, calm water, and clear atmospheric conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: A haunting portrait of a woman with cracked, aged skin and dark hair against a black background.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark, flowing hair frames the face, contrasting with the cracked, parchment-like skin texture.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The face appears static, with cracks spreading across the surface, suggesting decay or revelation.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Muted whites, browns, and grays dominate, with rough, fragmented textures and faded script patterns.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Artistic, stylized portrait with dramatic lighting, set against a solid black background for high contrast.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man sleeping on train while commuters stand on platform outside.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Passenger asleep inside train, others waiting outside on platform.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Sunlight casts shadows on platform, concrete floor with yellow tactile strips.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor train station platform during daytime with bright natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Young man sits leaning forward in dimly lit room with plain walls and floor.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Striped fabric draped over shoulder, wall outlet visible, and poster on right wall.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Subject gazes directly at camera, head tilted slightly, arms crossed over body.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White cotton shirt, black pants, muted gray wall, and worn greenish floor surface.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or controlled lighting environment with high contrast, shallow depth of field, and abstract composition.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman smokes a cigar under dramatic lighting with textured background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman with dark hair and ornate clothing holds a lit cigar near her lips.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Smoke curls from the cigar, illuminated by warm backlighting against streaked backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She gazes forward while holding the cigar, positioned centrally in the frame.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden tones contrast with dark shadows and textured fabric patterns.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor studio setting with stylized lighting and abstract background streaks.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant fireworks explode across dark night sky above silhouetted rooftops and trees.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Explosive fireworks display with white, blue, and orange bursts forming intricate patterns.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark silhouettes of rooftops and tree branches frame the lower portion of the scene.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Fireworks ascend and burst simultaneously, creating dynamic visual motion against the sky.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Bright white, vivid blue, and warm orange hues contrast with the deep black night background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime celebration with clear sky, festive lighting, and urban architectural elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouette of a person seated in a textured, geometrically shaped architectural space with windows.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A person sitting with legs crossed, viewed in profile against a bright window.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A small, framed object on a shelf within a recessed wall niche.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The person is seated alone, facing outward, positioned within a structured, angular interior.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black and white image with rough, unevenly textured walls and sharp geometric lines.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor architectural setting with strong directional lighting from windows, creating deep shadows.

codebook_texts.C_global: Store shelf displays colorful boxes of head-shaped popsicles with historical figures.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Brightly colored boxes contain lollipop-style treats shaped like famous people's heads.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background wall features posters of various cartoon characters and historical scenes.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Products are arranged on metal shelving, grouped by flavor and historical theme.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange, red, and yellow packaging with glossy plastic wrapping and printed illustrations.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor retail setting with fluorescent lighting and organized product displays.

codebook_texts.C_global: A large mushroom grows amidst vibrant green grass under a bright blue sky with tree branches overhead.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The mushroom has a broad, rounded cap with a textured surface and a sturdy stem supporting it.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Tall blades of grass partially obscure the base and foreground, framing the mushroom.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The mushroom stands upright in the grass, viewed from a low angle with natural sunlight illuminating it.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The cap displays a pale beige with speckled texture, while grass is vivid green and stems are slender and glossy.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting with clear daylight, trees in the background, and a bright blue sky visible above.

codebook_texts.C_global: Rocky shoreline with calm water reflecting sky and clouds under bright daylight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large, rounded yellowish-brown boulders sit partially submerged in shallow tide pools.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark seaweed and wet rocks form foreground textures near the water’s edge.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Still water mirrors sky and rocks, creating symmetrical reflections across the scene.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, wet rock surfaces contrast with rough, mossy textures under vibrant blue and white tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Coastal tide pool landscape under partly cloudy skies with natural daylight illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Moonlit coastal scene at twilight, with glowing water and silhouetted hills.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Crescent moon hangs low in deep blue sky above calm ocean waters.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant hillside town with scattered lights along shoreline edge.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person stands alone near water’s edge, gazing at horizon and moon.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant purple and pink hues reflect on rippling water surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal evening with twilight sky, calm sea, and mountainous backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: A vibrant green lacewing perches delicately on a purple and yellow flower, surrounded by pollen.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A slender green lacewing with transparent veined wings and large compound eyes.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A purple flower with bright yellow stamens and layered petals dusted with pollen.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The lacewing is positioned atop the flower, legs gripping petals while antennae extend forward.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green body, translucent wings with intricate veining, and vivid yellow pollen granules.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting with soft lighting, shallow depth of field, and blurred dark background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two people play near rocky shore, waves crash around them in vivid blue water.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person wearing red hat and blue top wades in shallow ocean water near rocks.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rugged dark rocks jut from water's edge, creating white foamy waves around them.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Individuals interact with ocean, one near rocks, waves splash around their feet.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blue water with turquoise highlights, textured rocks, and bright red hat contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal scene under bright sunlight, clear water revealing submerged stones.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two young boys sit indoors, focused on video games with controllers in hand.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A toddler in a blue outfit reclines on a silver lounge chair, holding a game controller.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A folding chair with blue and green accents holds the older boy playing a game.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Both children are engrossed in gaming, seated on different chairs facing the same direction.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth silver chair, green and blue folding chair, wooden floor with beige tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor living room with cabinets, carpeted floor, and ambient warm lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up portrait of a woman with drawn markings questioning facial perfection against dark background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman's face with drawn arrows and dotted lines suggesting cosmetic surgery or beauty standards.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark background contrasts sharply with illuminated facial features and markings.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Markings on face imply self-examination or societal pressure regarding beauty ideals.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Skin texture appears natural with subtle freckles, while ink markings are bold and black.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio-style lighting highlights facial details against a plain, dark backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: A small, wet fennec fox is being gently held in someone's hands inside a bathroom.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A tiny fennec fox with large ears, light fur, and dark eyes is cradled in human hands.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A circular drain cover is visible on the white tiled floor behind the animal.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The person holds the fox securely, supporting its body and paws while it looks forward.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft beige fur, pale skin, and glossy wet patches contrast with smooth white tiles.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor bathroom setting with bright, even lighting and clean white tiled walls.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person submerged in foamy bathwater, face partially visible through bubbles.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Human head with wet hair, eyes closed, immersed in bubbly water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Foamy white bubbles and murky greenish water surrounding the head.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person relaxing or bathing, head tilted back in tub, water covering face.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Pale skin tones, brownish hair, creamy foam, murky greenish water texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor bathroom setting, dim lighting, bathtub filled with soapy water.

codebook_texts.C_global: Urban street scene with vehicles, overpass, and buildings under cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Red compact car drives forward on multi-lane road beneath elevated walkway.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Large rusted billboard and multi-story buildings line the street background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Cars move along road while pedestrians and construction activity occur nearby.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Weathered concrete, faded red paint, and gray asphalt dominate the visual palette.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Overcast day in busy city environment with mixed architectural styles and traffic flow.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant red lily blooms in bright sunlight, surrounded by soft green foliage.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Petals curve outward with yellow center, stamens rise from core, vividly detailed.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurry green leaves and stems form soft background, enhancing flower's prominence.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Flower faces forward, stamens extend upward, petals spread wide in natural pose.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich red petals with yellow gradient, smooth surfaces, subtle veining visible.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene under direct sunlight, natural daylight illuminating vivid colors.

codebook_texts.C_global: A small ground squirrel stands upright in a grassy outdoor field, alert and curious.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: The squirrel has a rounded head, dark eyes, and fur-covered paws, standing on its hind legs.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred green grass and earthy patches form the background behind the squirrel.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The squirrel is positioned upright, facing slightly right, with its front paws held near its chest.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Furry brownish-gray coat with fine, soft-looking fur and subtle earthy tones across its body.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural setting with soft, diffused lighting and a shallow depth-of-field background.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman lounges comfortably on a light-colored sofa in a warmly lit living room setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman reclines with legs crossed, wearing dark clothing and high heels, holding a drink.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A patterned decorative pillow rests beside her, and a vase with orange flowers stands nearby.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She sits relaxed in a plush armchair, positioned near curtains and a television set.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft beige upholstery, rich brown curtains, and vibrant orange floral accents create a cozy palette.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor living room with natural light filtering through curtains, featuring furniture and decor.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dramatic red-hued sunset over water with silhouetted land and clouds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Silhouetted island with trees and structures near water's edge.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark shoreline vegetation and distant horizon line under cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Clouds reflect in water while island stands still against glowing sky.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant reds, oranges, and deep shadows create intense contrast across scene.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal landscape at dusk with dramatic weather and vivid lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Young woman with brown hair holds red parrot on shoulder indoors near glass door.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman with shoulder-length brown hair gazes sideways with neutral expression.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Vibrant red parrot with blue wing feathers perched on woman's shoulder.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Parrot sits calmly on shoulder while woman looks away, suggesting quiet companionship.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich red plumage contrasts with woman's soft skin tone and dark clothing texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with neutral walls, glass door, and soft ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant orange sunset illuminates river valley with silhouetted bridge and distant mountains.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Curved stone bridge spans river, lit by streetlights against darkening sky.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense tree line borders riverbanks, silhouetted against glowing horizon.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bridge connects urban buildings across winding river under dramatic sky.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Fiery orange and red hues blend with dark silhouettes and reflective water surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban riverside scene at twilight with dramatic cloud formations and artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A glowing, metallic sculpture resembling a circus performer stands illuminated in a dimly lit room.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A humanoid figure crafted from shiny metal pots, pans, and kitchenware, adorned with red fabric and tassels.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A wooden ladder leans against the wall beside the sculpture, with a polka-dotted cup resting on its top rung.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The sculpture is suspended by wires, positioned centrally with a stool and kettle in the background.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red fabric contrasts with reflective silver metal, accented by warm ambient lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: An indoor artistic installation space with wooden flooring, dim lighting, and rustic decor elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: A stylized illustration of a woman in a coral coat with a green headband, standing against a plain white background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman with long dark hair, wearing a double-breasted coat with patterned collar and pockets.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large green bow adorning her head, contrasting with her dark hair and coral coat.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The woman stands upright, facing forward, with her arms slightly away from her body, suggesting a poised stance.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Coral coat with black buttons, patterned collar and pockets, and a vibrant green headband against a white background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Minimalist studio-style portrait with plain white background, soft lighting, and no environmental context.

codebook_texts.C_global: Foggy park scene with bare trees lining a path where people stroll quietly in muted tones.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Silhouetted leafless trees stand in neat rows, their branches reaching upward against the haze.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Small human figures appear as dark shapes near benches, barely visible through the thick mist.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People walk or stand along the tree-lined path, spaced apart amid the foggy atmosphere.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic grayscale tones with smooth gradients and soft textures from fog and shadows.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor park setting under overcast, foggy conditions with diffused lighting and low visibility.

codebook_texts.C_global: Graffiti art on weathered concrete wall features cartoon elephants and a poetic message.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Three stylized cartoon elephants painted in blue and white with expressive faces.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Text reading 'To nite there are no D.R.E.A.M.S' and '2006' beneath the elephants.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Elephants arranged side by side with hearts, suggesting unity or emotional theme.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Weathered concrete with mottled brown and gray tones, showing peeling paint and rough surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban wall with graffiti, under natural daylight, likely in a city alley or underpass.

codebook_texts.C_global: Rainbow arcs over desert highway with stop sign, mountains, and cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Red octagonal stop sign mounted on wooden post with white border.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Divided highway sign with arrows pointing left and right below stop sign.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Stop sign stands at roadside intersection with traffic flow indicated by arrows.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant rainbow hues contrast with muted earth tones and cloudy sky textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor desert highway scene under partly cloudy sky with distant mountain range.

codebook_texts.C_global: A sepia-toned landscape features a lighthouse and buildings amid tall grass under a cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A tall, cylindrical lighthouse with a lantern room stands prominently in the distance.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A rusted, curved metal pipe juts from the ground in the foreground, partially buried in grass.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The lighthouse and adjacent buildings are positioned far behind the foreground pipe, creating depth.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Grass shows varied textures and tones, while the pipe has rough, corroded surfaces under muted lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: An outdoor, rural scene with overcast skies, tall grass, and aged structures suggesting abandonment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Excavator removes letters from vintage theater marquee under bright blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Large orange excavator arm with claw attachment positioned near theater sign.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Weathered stone facade with arched window and decorative molding above marquee.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Heavy machinery dismantles old signage while standing adjacent to historic building.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rust-orange metal, green-painted sign base, beige textured stone, and blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene during daytime with clear weather and visible power lines.

codebook_texts.C_global: Young woman with long hair sits in front of graffiti-covered wall with posters.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Woman with brown hair, wearing gray blazer, smiling slightly at camera.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black-and-white poster of chandelier and 'gold hick' text on wall behind her.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: She is seated, facing forward, positioned centrally against textured background.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark tones with high contrast, rough wall texture, and soft lighting on her face.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor urban setting with graffiti-covered walls, dim lighting, and artistic posters.

codebook_texts.C_global: Person wearing dark jacket holds vintage twin-lens reflex camera with leather strap.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Vintage twin-lens reflex camera with dual lenses and silver body hanging from neck strap.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark textured jacket with buttoned pockets and silver zipper pull visible.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Camera hangs around neck, positioned centrally against jacket front.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dark gray fabric with subtle weave, metallic silver camera accents, and brown leather strap.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor or shaded setting with soft lighting, focusing on upper torso and camera.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up black-and-white shot of guitar strings and bridge on instrument.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Strings stretch tautly over metallic bridge, converging toward headstock.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred background suggests indoor setting with soft ambient lighting.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Strings are anchored to bridge, creating tension across guitar body.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight metallic sheen and smooth wooden surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor studio or room with shallow depth of field and diffused lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A man kneels beside a graffiti-covered stone block near a coastal town with boats and buildings.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A shirtless man crouches on pebbles, focused on writing or drawing on a large stone structure.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A weathered statue atop the stone block, with visible graffiti including 'Sofia' and 'Viva la vida'.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The man interacts with the stone block, while boats rest in the water and buildings line the shore behind.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: The scene features muted blues, grays, and whites, with rough stone textures and faded graffiti markings.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal setting under bright daylight, with a pebble beach, calm water, and urban architecture in the background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted figure leaps energetically on sandy beach under dramatic cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Dynamic human silhouette mid-air, arms outstretched, hair flowing upward.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant person standing near shoreline, small shrubs dotting foreground sand.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person jumping from elevated sand mound, creating sense of motion and freedom.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm sepia tones dominate, textured sand, soft cloud gradients, dark shadowed forms.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor beach scene at dusk or dawn, overcast sky, natural coastal environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Blue Audi car parked on gravel road with dry grass and bright sky in background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Sleek blue sedan with distinctive taillights and alloy wheels angled toward viewer.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Side mirror, rear windshield wiper, and license plate area visible on vehicle.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Car positioned at low angle on rough surface, suggesting stationary outdoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Glossy blue paint, metallic wheel rims, and textured gravel ground under warm lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor roadside scene with dry vegetation, clear sky, and natural daylight illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime cityscape with futuristic architecture reflecting in calm water under cloudy sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Curved, sail-like white structure with glass panels and illuminated interior spaces.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Large dome-shaped building with 'ecile' text, supported by sleek arches over water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Buildings stand adjacent to waterfront, their lights mirrored in still water below.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden glow from artificial lighting contrasts with dark sky and reflective water surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban waterfront at night with dramatic lighting, cloudy atmosphere, and architectural landmarks.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dim, muted tones capture tangled dry grasses in a quiet, overcast outdoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Tangled, slender stalks of dried grass dominate the foreground with intricate, overlapping forms.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Soft, blurred background hints at distant vegetation and a pale, diffused sky above.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Grass blades intersect and layer across the frame, creating depth and natural randomness.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic palette of grays and browns with rough, fibrous textures and subtle highlights.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor, natural environment under soft, overcast lighting with muted atmospheric conditions.

codebook_texts.C_global: A person performs an acrobatic flip near a beach with mountains and cloudy skies in the background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A person mid-air, upside down, wearing light blue shirt and patterned shorts.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A large, weathered log lies horizontally on the sandy beach near the water.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The person is flipping over the log, with water and distant mountains behind them.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Sandy beige ground, dark gray log, light blue shirt, and cloudy gray sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor beach scene with calm water, overcast weather, and mountainous backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: White sign marks entry into Scituate, established 1636, under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: White, arched sign with black lettering and blue emblem reads 'Entering Scituate'.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Metal pole supports the sign, with distant treeline visible beneath clear sky.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Sign indicates arrival at town boundary, positioned prominently for travelers.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth white surface with bold black text and blue circular emblem against sky.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor roadside scene under bright daylight with clear blue sky and green treeline.

codebook_texts.C_global: Group of friends joyfully jumping outdoors in forested area during golden hour.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Teenagers mid-air, arms raised, smiling broadly, wearing casual clothing.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dense trees and grassy ground form natural backdrop behind jumping group.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: People arranged in staggered rows, all leaping simultaneously with energetic poses.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant blue jacket, earthy brown pants, and varied denim textures dominate scene.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor forest clearing with soft backlighting from setting sun casting long shadows.

codebook_texts.C_global: Overwater bungalow perched on wooden stilts above crystal-clear turquoise waters under bright blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Single-story wooden bungalow with slanted roof and open-air design, elevated on sturdy pilings.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant green island with dense vegetation visible across calm ocean horizon.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Structure built directly over water, supported by wooden deck and pilings extending into sea.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant turquoise water, deep blue sky, weathered wood texture, and gray corrugated roof panels.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Tropical coastal paradise with clear sunny weather, calm sea, and serene island backdrop.

codebook_texts.C_global: Passengers ride subway train, reflections and graffiti visible on glass window.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Person holding camera, capturing image through reflective subway car window.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Yellow wall with black graffiti, metallic poles, and seated commuters inside train.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Reflections show multiple passengers reading, sitting, or holding devices inside train.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Yellow textured wall, black spray-painted graffiti, metallic silver poles and glass surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor subway train environment, artificial lighting, enclosed public transportation setting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Stone bridge spans calm canal, surrounded by lush green trees and historic buildings.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Arched brick bridge with metal railing, supporting bicycles and pedestrians above water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Reflections of bridge and trees shimmer on canal surface, with moored boats visible in distance.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bicycles rest on bridge railing, while canal flows beneath arches connecting urban streets.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Mossy green water, weathered brick, and vibrant foliage contrast with smooth stone and metal railings.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban canal scene under bright daylight, with historic architecture and natural vegetation.

codebook_texts.C_global: Colorful, decorated keyboard with whimsical designs and text overlays on each key.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Keyboard with keys covered in various artistic patterns and phrases like 'Magic Chef' and 'Divine Harp Steps'.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red border with text 'NO INCOMING CALLS' and 'Divine Harp Steps' at the bottom of the keyboard.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Keys arranged in standard QWERTY layout, but each key has unique decorative elements and text.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant mix of reds, blues, yellows, and patterns including stars, stripes, and cartoon characters.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor, close-up shot of a customized keyboard with artistic and playful design elements.

codebook_texts.C_global: Monochrome Gothic vaulted ceiling with intricate ribbed patterns and arched windows overhead.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Ribbed vaulted ceiling with intersecting stone ribs forming pointed arches and decorative bosses.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Circular stained glass window with tracery visible beneath the vaulted ceiling structure.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Ceiling ribs converge at central points, creating symmetrical geometric patterns across the space.
